text: Nau hena vavade vedauauwuu haudānajauāhehauau haeaudenauau, haeaunaunehanauau haeaunauyauhauvanauau hedajauanenau vegau.

text: Nau, wauhā, Vahadāde hedautheaune haeedasā, nau havathee haeseenauasāaunauau Vahadānith; nau haevasenāthajaunauau.

text_for_embed: Luke 2:10 — Nau hautheaun jevanāthajauau hathāhaugaunee: hanau, naune, nauuchaudaunathana hethadee waunauyauau havathee neethajaude, nanaa heee vahee henanedanede.

text: Havathee hauwaunede hesee Hejavaneauthau hejavaa, nau dasee vedauauwuu nanethauaunee, hethadee hathanavana henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:14 — Havathee hauwaunede hesee Hejavaneauthau hejavaa, nau dasee vedauauwuu nanethauaunee, hethadee hathanavana henanedanede.

text: Nau hethauwuu, hautheaunauau haejaenauthā hesee hejavaa, Wauhā hadeehaunau Bethlehem, hanathadagaunee nuu haudānajauāhehauau, nau nauhaudauwuu nuu hayewhu javeauau, nanaa Vahadāde hāāedauwunādaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:15 — Nau hethauwuu, hautheaunauau haejaenauthā hesee hejavaa, Wauhā hadeehaunau Bethlehem, hanathadagaunee nuu haudānajauāhehauau, nau nauhaudauwuu nuu hayewhu javeauau, nanaa Vahadāde hāāedauwunādaunene.

text: Nau haenauchuhanauusanauau, nau haeveehanauau Mare nau Joseph, nau dāeyaunauau haesaeseene hewauchuhauchauwauauwuu henee nedauvethehenethe hewauchuhauchāve.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:16 — Nau haenauchuhanauusanauau, nau haeveehanauau Mare nau Joseph, nau dāeyaunauau haesaeseene hewauchuhauchauwauauwuu henee nedauvethehenethe hewauchuhauchāve.

text: Nau hāenauhauwauthee, haeneānauthedanauau nuu hathauthedaunāhethee heee dāeyaunauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:17 — Nau hāenauhauwauthee, haeneānauthedanauau nuu hathauthedaunāhethee heee dāeyaunauau.

text: Nau vahee hathāenedauvade haegaugauanadauwu henee hayauhuhau nuu hathauthedaunāthee haudānajauāhehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:18 — Nau vahee hathāenedauvade haegaugauanadauwu henee hayauhuhau nuu hathauthedaunāthee haudānajauāhehau.

text: Nau Mare haeaunaunede vahee nuu hayauhuhau, nau haegaugauanade hedahaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:19 — Nau Mare haeaunaunede vahee nuu hayauhuhau, nau haegaugauanade hedahaa.

text: Nau haudānajauāhehauau haejaesanauau, haevaveenethedaunanauau nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu heee vahee hanathadauvathee nau hathauhauthāthee, neethāedauwunāhethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:20 — Nau haudānajauāhehauau haejaesanauau, haevaveenethedaunanauau nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu heee vahee hanathadauvathee nau hathauhauthāthee, neethāedauwunāhethee.

text: Nau hāenasaudauchunesee hadneegauguusede dāeyaunaa heneseede Jesus, haseadagu nuu haseede haenaneeseāde hautheaunau haunauau deejethāsee.

text: Nau hesee hāewaudeauchaude hasaunee hedauchuwude Moses hāevadauaunee, haeyehauthanauau hesee Dadaunedan hadjenanauwunauthee Vahadāhenith;

text: Nau, naune, hena henane haeanedau Dādaunedan, Simeon haenaneeseede; nau naa henane haechuvā nau haeethauwuthajau, haeejauwuwude hadneneethajauthee Israel: nau Vadanauwauthauwu haethāsade.

text: Nau haeeauthedaunaa Vadanauwauthauwu, henee hadjenauhaudauau gaujauaudahede, haunaude hadnauhauwaude Vahadāhenith Chris.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:26 — Nau haeeauthedaunaa Vadanauwauthauwu, henee hadjenauhaudauau gaujauaudahede, haunaude hadnauhauwaude Vahadāhenith Chris.

text: Nau Simeon haevevethasa, nau haeāedauwuna Mareheau henaune, Naune, Naa dāeyaunaa haneejenanade hadneaunenauaudenenee nau hadneejaegauhadenenee hauwauhuu Israel; nau hanau nauhauthethau hadnevathevade;

text: Nau haeenevesāne heee nasaudausauau yānenee jajene, nananede haeejethauunaude vadannauauwuu, hau haenesedauna Hejavaeneauthu nauguu naugauyaude nau vevethahede dajāee nau hesee.

text: Nau haejejedā heee haevaveene jea Vahadāhenith, nau haeheauthedauna vahee nethāejauwuwudethee jauaudaunauthadede jedauwuu Dādaunedan.

text: Nau hese hāevadauaunee, hāejāesathee, dāeyaunaa Hejavaneauthusau haenasedauusa Dādaunedan; nau Joseph nau henaune haejaenauwu.

text: Hau henanedaa haenehauvā hathanauwauhaugaunee, nau haejanaugudaunee; hanaāenaudehauthee henedauānene nau henedaehāhene.

text_for_embed: Luke 2:45 — Nau hāejeveehauthee, haejaesanauau hesee Dādaunedan, daunaudehauthee.

text: Nau hethauwuu hāenasese hanaāeveehauthee jedauwuu vadannauauwuu, haetheaugune nahethāe hauthedahehau, haejaatheha, nau haenaunaudedauna.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:46 — Nau hethauwuu hāenasese hanaāeveehauthee jedauwuu vadannauauwuu, haetheaugune nahethāe hauthedahehau, haejaatheha, nau haenaunaudedauna.

text: Nau vahee hathāenedauwauthāthee haegaugauanadauwu hedaeyaunene nau hedauchuhanehedaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:47 — Nau vahee hathāenedauwauthāthee haegaugauanadauwu hedaeyaunene nau hedauchuhanehedaunene.

text: Nau hāenauhauwauthee, haegaugauanavanauau: nau henaune, Nā, naudu hanesehāane? hathāhuk, naune hāsaunau nau nananenau nenaudehane nejeneethajaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:48 — Nau hāenauhauwauthee, haegaugauanavanauau: nau henaune, Nā, naudu hanesehāane? hathāhuk, naune hāsaunau nau nananenau nenaudehane nejeneethajaunee.

text: Nau hathauhuk, naudu haenaudehena? gauhajaene nauchāe wauwu hanedaudauwau Nāsaunau henesethaude?
text_for_embed: Luke 2:49 — Nau hathauhuk, naudu haenaudehena? gauhajaene nauchāe wauwu hanedaudauwau Nāsaunau henesethaude?

text: Nau haejaenauwu hasenehethāthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:50 — Nau haejaenauwu hasenehethāthee.

text: Nau hanaāenethaunaude, nau haenauusanauau Nazareth, nau haeethauwaudaunā: hau henaune haeaunaunedene vahee nuu nehedaunau hedahaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:51 — Nau hanaāenethaunaude, nau haenauusanauau Nazareth, nau haeethauwaudaunā: hau henaune haeaunaunedene vahee nuu nehedaunau hedahaa.

text: Nau Hejavaneathusau haeneenaneaune hedaeyau nau hajedāde nau vechauthaude Hejavaneauthu nau henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 2:52 — Nau Hejavaneathusau haeneenaneaune hedaeyau nau hajedāde nau vechauthaude Hejavaneauthu nau henanedanede.

text: Wauhā yauthaunenee jajene wauwu neeenajanede Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pinade nausunajawaudauau Judea, nau Herod nanajawaudauau Gananee, nau henauhauwauau Theneb nanajawaudauau Iturea nau vedauauwuu Trachonitis, nau Lysanias naja Abilene,
text_for_embed: Luke 3:1 — Wauhā yauthaunenee jajene wauwu neeenajanede Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pinade nausunajawaudauau Judea, nau Herod nanajawaudauau Gananee, nau henauhauwauau Theneb nanajawaudauau Iturea nau vedauauwuu Trachonitis, nau Lysanias naja Abilene,

text: Annas nau Caiaphas vevethahenajanauau, Hejavaneauthu nanadede haeedasaa Jaun heau Zacharias nauaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 3:2 — Annas nau Caiaphas vevethahenajanauau, Hejavaneauthu nanadede haeedasaa Jaun heau Zacharias nauaunee.

text: Nau haeedade vahee vedauauwuu hanathaudanee Jordan, haeauthedaude dusaahede haudneaugauthuu gaugauuthajaudenau hadneegudanee wauchudaudenau;
text_for_embed: Luke 3:3 — Nau haeedade vahee vedauauwuu hanathaudanee Jordan, haeauthedaude dusaahede haudneaugauthuu gaugauuthajaudenau hadneegudanee wauchudaudenau;

text: Naathauthaunauhuu wauthaunauhanaa hedanadede Esaias haeyāhe, Jasaye haevasenehe nauaunee, Hesaanuu hathaāhede Vahadāhede, nesedee hevau chwuwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 3:4 — Naathauthaunauhuu wauthaunauhanaa hedanadede Esaias haeyāhe, Jasaye haevasenehe nauaunee, Hesaanuu hathaāhede Vahadāhede, nesedee hevau chwuwuu.

text: Hadauchugauaudayauau hadnechauchaunaa, nau hadauchāe hauane nau jauaudane hadjananee, nau jajāvāe hadchuvanee, nau hadauhauauyauau bau hadneyauthauau;
text_for_embed: Luke 3:5 — Hadauchugauaudayauau hadnechauchaunaa, nau hadauchāe hauane nau jauaudane hadjananee, nau jajāvāe hadchuvanee, nau hadauhauauyauau bau hadneyauthauau;

text: Nau vahee henanedanede hadnauhaudauau Hejavaneathu hedenayauthaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 3:6 — Nau vahee henanedanede hadnauhaudauau Hejavaneathu hedenayauthaunene.

text: Haenaāenehethaude waunauthanee henanedanede henee hedasādaunau haddusaanaude, Hau hedenaededaunenau seseyānauau, hanaa hāedauwunādaunenau haddaugauhudauwuna nauthee hasenaunaude hadnauusanauau?
text_for_embed: Luke 3:7 — Haenaāenehethaude waunauthanee henanedanede henee hedasādaunau haddusaanaude, Hau hedenaededaunenau seseyānauau, hanaa hāedauwunādaunenau haddaugauhudauwuna nauthee hasenaunaude hadnauusanauau?

text: Nau vahee haegaugauanavaa, nau haeanadethadenenau jaee, nuu hayew hanadede; hathāhuk, hethauwuu nauguu haenauthenehetha haenesedauwauna wauchāhenethe haujaunau, nau hanaāejenauāhethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:36 — Nau vahee haegaugauanavaa, nau haeanadethadenenau jaee, nuu hayew hanadede; hathāhuk, hethauwuu nauguu haenauthenehetha haenesedauwauna wauchāhenethe haujaunau, nau hanaāejenauāhethee.

text: Hanaāauthedaunenede nanadee jasesee gauānee vedauauwuu,

text: Nau haegauhā haenauā vevethahenauauwuu, nau haejedā Simon hedauauwuu. Nau Simon henene henaunene haenaudauwauvāhene; nau haeautheawaunauthasanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:38 — Nau haegauhā haenauā vevethahenauauwuu, nau haejedā Simon hedauauwuu. Nau Simon henene henaunene haenaudauwauvāhene; nau haeautheawaunauthasanauau.

text: Nau haetheaugudauna, nau haeneude hasauwauvahede; nau haenauthaa: nau nauhauhaunee haegauhā nau haedauyauhauvanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:39 — Nau haetheaugudauna, nau haeneude hasauwauvahede; nau haenauthaa: nau nauhauhaunee haegauhā nau haedauyauhauvanauau.

text: Wauhā hesese hāenaesade vahee hathāenethenauthee hasauwauvahehehau hanasejaechauwauvāhenethe haenauuchaudaunau; nau haedajevasana nau haeenayauha.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:40 — Wauhā hesese hāenaesade vahee hathāenethenauthee hasauwauvahehehau hanasejaechauwauvāhenethe haenauuchaudaunau; nau haedajevasana nau haeenayauha.

text: Nau haujaunauau nauguu haevanauusanauau haewauthanauau, haeneānadenauau, nau haenehenauau, Nananene Chris Heau Hejavaneauthau. Nau haeneneuva haejechuwauanadeha: dauhaenauwunethe dau Chris denede.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:41 — Nau haujaunauau nauguu haevanauusanauau haewauthanauau, haeneānadenauau, nau haenehenauau, Nananene Chris Heau Hejavaneauthau. Nau haeneneuva haejechuwauanadeha: dauhaenauwunethe dau Chris denede.

text: Nau hāesenenee, hanaāejathāaude hesee hadaunechaudanee, nau henanedanau haenaudehaa, nau haeedasaa, nau haedauduvaa, haudjenauthaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:42 — Nau hāesenenee, hanaāejathāaude hesee hadaunechaudanee, nau henanedanau haenaudehaa, nau haeedasaa, nau haedauduvaa, haudjenauthaude.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, haudnauthedaudauwau najanede Hejavaneauthau gauchuhunee hedanau nauguu: haugaunaasejejenananau.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:43 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, haudnauthedaudauwau najanede Hejavaneauthau gauchuhunee hedanau nauguu: haugaunaasejejenananau.

text: Nau haeautheda vevethahenauauwuu Gananee.
text_for_embed: Luke 4:44 — Nau haeautheda vevethahenauauwuu Gananee.

text: Nau hethauwuu, henanedanede haeneenavadaunedauwaudauwu hedanadedaunene Hejavaneauthu, haetheaugu sasethauwu neajee Gennesaret,
text_for_embed: Luke 5:1 — Nau hethauwuu, henanedanede haeneenavadaunedauwaudauwu hedanadedaunene Hejavaneauthu, haetheaugu sasethauwu neajee Gennesaret,

text: Nau haenauhaude hanesanenee thewaunau haetheaugunenau sasethauwu neajee: hau naunauyāhehauau haeeyauhaudesanauau, nau haeanahesadenauau henauyaudenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:2 — Nau haenauhaude hanesanenee thewaunau haetheaugunenau sasethauwu neajee: hau naunauyāhehauau haeeyauhaudesanauau, nau haeanahesadenauau henauyaudenenau.

text: Nau haejedā jasaa hethewaunene, Simon, nau haenehetha hadwauauwuhudede vanehaa hehethee vachuwauauwuu vedauauwuu. Nau haejanaugu, nau haeechauhautheha henanedanau hehethee thewaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:3 — Nau haejedā jasaa hethewaunene, Simon, nau haenehetha hadwauauwuhudede vanehaa hehethee vachuwauauwuu vedauauwuu. Nau haejanaugu, nau haeechauhautheha henanedanau hehethee thewaunaa.

text: Wauhā hāevadauthedade, hanaāenehethaude Simon, wauauwuhude hadaudavee, nau henauwunau haunauyaude hadjathāne.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:4 — Wauhā hāevadauthedade, hanaāenehethaude Simon, wauauwuhude hadaudavee, nau henauwunau haunauyaude hadjathāne.

text: Nau Simon hanaāauchuhananadethaude, Hechauhauthethāhe, naunaugaunenesethānauau, nau nāhauwuthauujathāva: hau hegaugaunauau hadnaaenauwuaudenau nauyaude haugau hasenehene.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:5 — Nau Simon hanaāauchuhananadethaude, Hechauhauthethāhe, naunaugaunenesethānauau, nau nāhauwuthauujathāva: hau hegaugaunauau hadnaaenauwuaudenau nauyaude haugau hasenehene.

text: Nau hāesedauthee nuu haewauthanenau hejathaunenau, nau haethauwunauaune henauyaudenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:6 — Nau hāesedauthee nuu haewauthanenau hejathaunenau, nau haethauwunauaune henauyaudenenau.

text: Nau haeadethanauau henedaehahenau danachaugunethe jasaa thewaunaa, haudjaunethe, nau haudnedāhevāthee. Nau haenauusanenau, nau haeechauchaunaudenauau hanesanenee thewaunau hanaāenauwuuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:7 — Nau haeadethanauau henedaehahenau danachaugunethe jasaa thewaunaa, haudjaunethe, nau haudnedāhevāthee. Nau haenauusanenau, nau haeechauchaunaudenauau hanesanenee thewaunau hanaāenauwuuu.

text: Hāenauhaudauau Simon Peda, haechauāgujanaugu hejaedayānene Hejavaneauthusaun, nauchu, hathāhuk; haugauhauhauganenau, Hau Vahadāhene.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:8 — Hāenauhaudauau Simon Peda, haechauāgujanaugu hejaedayānene Hejavaneauthusaun, nauchu, hathāhuk; haugauhauhauganenau, Hau Vahadāhene.

text: Haejenaunethajau, nau vahee hethāenethaunādaunau daunauanauthee nauwu hejathaunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:9 — Haejenaunethajau, nau vahee hethāenethaunādaunau daunauanauthee nauwu hejathaunenau.

text: Nau nauguu James, nau Jaun, heauhau Zebedee, henedaehauhau Simon. Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude Simon, Jevanāthajau, hewaunehaa heee nananene haudnesedanaude henanenauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:10 — Nau nauguu James, nau Jaun, heauhau Zebedee, henedaehauhau Simon. Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude Simon, Jevanāthajau, hewaunehaa heee nananene haudnesedanaude henanenauau.

text: Nau hāenauuchaudethee hethewaunenau vedauauwuu, hanaāenauduu vahee, nau hanaāenethauguhauthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:11 — Nau hāenauuchaudethee hethewaunenau vedauauwuu, hanaāenauduu vahee, nau hanaāenethauguhauthee.

text: Nau hethauwuu, hāanedaude jasaa hedan, naune henane haeechauchaunaude naunaujaunee haugauwude; hāenauhauwaude Hejavaneauthusaun haeuāneseve, nau haeautheava, Vahadāhene, vathehānenagu hadeneeyaudanene hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:12 — Nau hethauwuu, hāanedaude jasaa hedan, naune henane haeechauchaunaude naunaujaunee haugauwude; hāenauhauwaude Hejavaneauthusaun haeuāneseve, nau haeautheava, Vahadāhene, vathehānenagu hadeneeyaudanene hathauhuk.

text: Nau haeyethauha, nau haevasana, vanathehānau: heyaudāhe, hathaukuk. Nau nauhauhaunee naunaujaunee haugauwude haenauthaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:13 — Nau haeyethauha, nau haevasana, vanathehānau: heyaudāhe, hathaukuk. Nau nauhauhaunee naunaujaunee haugauwude haenauthaa.

text: Nau haenesedauwaunā haudjāedauwunaunith henanedane: hau najesa hadnauhauthehau hadanayau vevethahevāhe, nau hadvā dauhenayauhane, Mosase neesedauvade, haudneāenuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:14 — Nau haenesedauwaunā haudjāedauwunaunith henanedane: hau najesa hadnauhauthehau hadanayau vevethahevāhe, nau hadvā dauhenayauhane, Mosase neesedauvade, haudneāenuu.

text: Hau haeneenanauthedaunene neānee: nau havathee haewautha henanedanede haeauānauuchaudene daujewaunejaathededaunee, nau haudnenayauhāthee hedasauwauvahedaunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:15 — Hau haeneenanauthedaunene neānee: nau havathee haewautha henanedanede haeauānauuchaudene daujewaunejaathededaunee, nau haudnenayauhāthee hedasauwauvahedaunenau.

text: Nau haejathāau hesee nauaunee, nau haevevetha.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:16 — Nau haejathāau hesee nauaunee, nau haevevetha.

text: Nau hethauwuu jasaa hesee, hajesechauhauthethāde, Nesethajauhuhauau nau hechauhaudauwauhuhauau nanavaavede haetheaugunauau hejava, haejeehedesanauau hadauchāe hauwauhauauwudan Gananee, nau Judea, nau Dādaunedan: nau naunaudāde Vahadāde haetheaugu hadnenayauhaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:17 — Nau hethauwuu jasaa hesee, hajesechauhauthethāde, Nesethajauhuhauau nau hechauhaudauwauhuhauau nanavaavede haetheaugunauau hejava, haejeehedesanauau hadauchāe hauwauhauauwudan Gananee, nau Judea, nau Dādaunedan: nau naunaudāde Vahadāde haetheaugu hadnenayauhaude.

text: Nau, naune, henanenauau haenauuchauhanauau henanene heee hedauwune haeesevāhene nau haenayāthejedananauau, nau hadjenanauwunauthee hathaājenith,
text_for_embed: Luke 5:18 — Nau, naune, henanenauau haenauuchauhanauau henanene heee hedauwune haeesevāhene nau haenayāthejedananauau, nau hadjenanauwunauthee hathaājenith,

text: Nau hāejeveedethee haudnethejedanauthee hanau dauwauthaa henanedanede, hanaāenauauhusathee dasee hauauwuu, nau haejanauhaujānanauau, hehethee dasee hejavaa hauauwuu nauguu hedauwune nahethāe hathaājenith Hejavaneauthusaun.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:19 — Nau hāejeveedethee haudnethejedanauthee hanau dauwauthaa henanedanede, hanaāenauauhusathee dasee hauauwuu, nau haejanauhaujānanauau, hehethee dasee hejavaa hauauwuu nauguu hedauwune nahethāe hathaājenith Hejavaneauthusaun.

text: Nau hāenauhaudauwunith hedethauwuthajaudenenau, hanaāāedauwunaude, Henane, hauwauchudaude gaunudanauwunane.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:20 — Nau hāenauhaudauwunith hedethauwuthajaudenenau, hanaāāedauwunaude, Henane, hauwauchudaude gaunudanauwunane.

text: Nau wauthaunauhāhehauau Nau Nesethajauhuhauau hanaāejasesegaugauuthajauthee, Hanaa naa hananadede nehedaduhude Hejavaneauthu? hathāhuk. Hanaa haudgudanauau wauchudaude, vavade Hejavaneauthau, naanesāde?
text_for_embed: Luke 5:21 — Nau wauthaunauhāhehauau Nau Nesethajauhuhauau hanaāejasesegaugauuthajauthee, Hanaa naa hananadede nehedaduhude Hejavaneauthu? hathāhuk. Hanaa haudgudanauau wauchudaude, vavade Hejavaneauthau, naanesāde?

text: Hau hāaenauwunith Hejavaneauthusaun hegaugauuthajaudenenau, Haudusethajauva hadahenauau? hathāhaugaunee,

text: Hau hadaenauwu henee Heau henane naunaudāde dasee hathāauauvadee negudanauau wauchudaude, (naasenehethauhaugu neasauwauvahedauwunith hesevahede) Hāedauwunathane, Gauhā, nau hedanau hauddau nau najesa nananene haudauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:24 — Hau hadaenauwu henee Heau henane naunaudāde dasee hathāauauvadee negudanauau wauchudaude, (naasenehethauhaugu neasauwauvahedauwunith hesevahede) Hāedauwunathane, Gauhā, nau hedanau hauddau nau najesa nananene haudauauwuu.

text: Nau nauhauhaunee haethauwauthe hathaājenethe nau haeedane heaugusenadenau nau hanaāejathāaude hedauauwuu haevaveenethedauna Hejavaneauthu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:25 — Nau nauhauhaunee haethauwauthe hathaājenethe nau haeedane heaugusenadenau nau hanaāejathāaude hedauauwuu haevaveenethedauna Hejavaneauthu.

text: Nau vahee haegaugauuthajaudene nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu, nau haeechauchaunaudenauau nāthajaude, Naunaudauhauthānauau nuu desene, hāheagu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:26 — Nau vahee haegaugauuthajaudene nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu, nau haeechauchaunaudenauau nāthajaude, Naunaudauhauthānauau nuu desene, hāheagu.

text: Nau hāevathedaude haejathāau nau haenauhauva hauāyāhe Levi hanaaseenith, haetheaugune nedauudanauau hauāyaunau, nau jethauguhu hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:27 — Nau hāevathedaude haejathāau nau haenauhauva hauāyāhe Levi hanaaseenith, haetheaugune nedauudanauau hauāyaunau, nau jethauguhu hathauhuk.

text: Nau haevanauthā, haegauhā, nau haethauguha.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:28 — Nau haevanauthā, haegauhā, nau haethauguha.

text: Nau Levi haevasevetheheha nehayau hedauauwuu, nau haewauthanauau hauāyāhehauau nau hauthauau haenedauguvā.

text: Hau wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhauau haeaunevā hethauguhādaunau, naudu haenethevethehewauna nau haenedaveyāwauna hauāyāhehauau nau wauchudauhuhauau, hathāhaugaunee?
text_for_embed: Luke 5:30 — Hau wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhauau haeaunevā hethauguhādaunau, naudu haenethevethehewauna nau haenedaveyāwauna hauāyāhehauau nau wauchudauhuhauau, hathāhaugaunee?

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusaun hanaāauchuhananadethāthee, hathāedāenaedethee hehauwuvathehā naudaunehāhew; hau hathāasauwauvahethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:31 — Nau Hejavaneauthusaun hanaāauchuhananadethāthee, hathāedāenaedethee hehauwuvathehā naudaunehāhew; hau hathāasauwauvahethee.

text: Nāhauwujenauusa haudnadethu hethahethee hau wauchudauhuhauau hadnaugaudanenee hegaugauuthajaudenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:32 — Nāhauwujenauusa haudnadethu hethahethee hau wauchudauhuhauau hadnaugaudanenee hegaugauuthajaudenenau.

text: Nau hathāhuk naudu hethauguhādaunau Jaun denauaunenaugauyānethe, nau devevethahethee, nau naasedauthee hethauguhādaunenau Nesethajauhuhauau; hau hanethenaunauau havethehethee nau havaveyāthee?
text_for_embed: Luke 5:33 — Nau hathāhuk naudu hethauguhādaunau Jaun denauaunenaugauyānethe, nau devevethahethee, nau naasedauthee hethauguhādaunenau Nesethajauhuhauau; hau hanethenaunauau havethehethee nau havaveyāthee?

text: Nau hathāhaugaunee, Gauhājeneenesehauva dāeyaunauauau nedauenenedaunee hauauwuu naugauyaude hajesanedaudaunāthee waunenenehew?
text_for_embed: Luke 5:34 — Nau hathāhaugaunee, Gauhājeneenesehauva dāeyaunauauau nedauenenedaunee hauauwuu naugauyaude hajesanedaudaunāthee waunenenehew?

text: Hau hese haudnauauchuu, haudneedanauwunana waunenenehe, nau heee hadnaāenaugauyāthee hena hese.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:35 — Hau hese haudnauauchuu, haudneedanauwunana waunenenehe, nau heee hadnaāenaugauyāthee hena hese.

text: Nau hanaāanadethaude jea jegausauhānee; Henane hehauwu jenane waunauyaunee neauthayew hadaugauthāyaunee, hith hesedauhuk, nau hadauwauyaunee needaudenauuu, nau jasaa needanee hadau wauyaunee hehauwuneauchauna gauthāyaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:36 — Nau hanaāanadethaude jea jegausauhānee; Henane hehauwu jenane waunauyaunee neauthayew hadaugauthāyaunee, hith hesedauhuk, nau hadauwauyaunee needaudenauuu, nau jasaa needanee hadau wauyaunee hehauwuneauchauna gauthāyaunee.

text: Nau hegau henane hehauwujenane waunauyaunee vasevenenaje gauthānenevajaunaa; nau wauāthe wauyaugu vasevenenaje haddaudeauau nevajaunau, nau hadgusenauauau, nau nevajaunau haddenanaunauuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:37 — Nau hegau henane hehauwujenane waunauyaunee vasevenenaje gauthānenevajaunaa; nau wauāthe wauyaugu vasevenenaje haddaudeauau nevajaunau, nau hadgusenauauau, nau nevajaunau haddenanaunauuu.

text: Hau waunauyauau vasevenenaje hadedaunee hadauwauyauau nevajau, nau nanesauuthadee.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:38 — Hau waunauyauau vasevenenaje hadedaunee hadauwauyauau nevajau, nau nanesauuthadee.

text: Nau hegau henane hesevanaagu gauthānevasevenenaje nauhauhaunee haevathehaa waunauyaunee; hanau gauthāyauau hethadee, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 5:39 — Nau hegau henane hesevanaagu gauthānevasevenenaje nauhauhaunee haevathehaa waunauyaunee; hanau gauthāyauau hethadee, hathauhuk.

text: Nau hethauwuu naneseauwauau vadanesee, haeehedesa jenayaunaa; nau hethauguhādaunau haegaugauunauwu wauchuunethauauhanau, nau haevethenauau, haegauneegudenauau hejadenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:1 — Nau hethauwuu naneseauwauau vadanesee, haeehedesa jenayaunaa; nau hethauguhādaunau haegaugauunauwu wauchuunethauauhanau, nau haevethenauau, haegauneegudenauau hejadenenau.

text: Nau hauthauauau Nesethajauhuhau, Naudu hanesedauna waujaa nanavanau nesedaude vadanesee hathauhaugaunee?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:2 — Nau hauthauauau Nesethajauhuhau, Naudu hanesedauna waujaa nanavanau nesedaude vadanesee hathauhaugaunee?

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhananadethaude, Gauhājethaunauhaude nuu hasauau David neesedaude, nehayau deasenade, nau neethāenethaunāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:3 — Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhananadethaude, Gauhājethaunauhaude nuu hasauau David neesedaude, nehayau deasenade, nau neethāenethaunāde.

text: Neesejedāde Hejavaneauthu hedauauwunene, nau needanauau nau nevethee nauhauthethājauaujau, nau haevena heethāenethaunaunau; waujaa nanavanau veyāgu hau jasaa vevethahevahehauau?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:4 — Neesejedāde Hejavaneauthu hedauauwunene, nau needanauau nau nevethee nauhauthethājauaujau, nau haevena heethāenethaunaunau; waujaa nanavanau veyāgu hau jasaa vevethahevahehauau?

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunāthee, Heau henane nanethadāde vadanesee.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:5 — Nau hanaāāedauwunāthee, Heau henane nanethadāde vadanesee.

text: Nau hethauwuu jea jasaa vadanesee haejedā vevethahenauauwuu nau haeautheda: nau henane haeanedau hejavese hejadenaa haeesevane,
text_for_embed: Luke 6:6 — Nau hethauwuu jea jasaa vadanesee haejedā vevethahenauauwuu nau haeautheda: nau henane haeanedau hejavese hejadenaa haeesevane,

text: Nau wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhau haeaunauyauhauvaa, wauau haadenenayauthā vadanesee; hadnejauaudaunauthee dauhanājauwauaunauthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:7 — Nau wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhau haeaunauyauhauvaa, wauau haadenenayauthā vadanesee; hadnejauaudaunauthee dauhanājauwauaunauthee.

text: Hau haeaenauwu hegaugauuthajaudenenau nau hanaāanadethaude henanene hesevenasanith, Gauhā nau yethaagu nahethāe. Nau haegauhā nau haeyethaagu.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:8 — Hau haeaenauwu hegaugauuthajaudenenau nau hanaāanadethaude henanene hesevenasanith, Gauhā nau yethaagu nahethāe. Nau haegauhā nau haeyethaagu.

text: Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude, haudnaudedaunathana nananena hanesadee; Gaujenanavanau vadanesee hethadāgu hasedaunee, nau wauāthe wauchudauneagu? henayauhāgu henaedede, nau wauāthe nanaunehāgu?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:9 — Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude, haudnaudedaunathana nananena hanesadee; Gaujenanavanau vadanesee hethadāgu hasedaunee, nau wauāthe wauchudauneagu? henayauhāgu henaedede, nau wauāthe nanaunehāgu?

text: Nau hanaāenaunauānede vahee, hanaāāedauwunaude henanene, Segauha hajade. Nau hanaasedaude: nau hejade haeenayauhune jasaa hasaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:10 — Nau hanaāenaunauānede vahee, hanaāāedauwunaude henanene, Segauha hajade. Nau hanaasedaude: nau hejade haeenayauhune jasaa hasaunee.

text: Nau haeechauchaunaudenauau hasenaunaude: nau hanaāaunauchuwuhadethee daun haudnesehauthee Hejavaneauthusaun.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:11 — Nau haeechauchaunaudenauau hasenaunaude: nau hanaāaunauchuwuhadethee daun haudnesehauthee Hejavaneauthusaun.

text: Hethauwuu hena hese, haeehau hauanee haudnevevethahede, nau haunaude naugaunee haevevethedauna Hejavaneauthu.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:12 — Hethauwuu hena hese, haeehau hauanee haudnevevethahede, nau haunaude naugaunee haevevethedauna Hejavaneauthu.

text: Nau hāesenee, hanaāadethaude hethauguhādaunau; nau haeedana vadadauchunesenee, hanaāeneseaude vadauhanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:13 — Nau hāesenee, hanaāadethaude hethauguhādaunau; nau haeedana vadadauchunesenee, hanaāeneseaude vadauhanauau.

text: Simoneau (jea haeaugauthea Peda haseauhuk), nau Andwheau henauhauwauau, James nau Jaun, Thenib, nau Bathaunaumew,
text_for_embed: Luke 6:14 — Simoneau (jea haeaugauthea Peda haseauhuk), nau Andwheau henauhauwauau, James nau Jaun, Thenib, nau Bathaunaumew,

text: Matthew, nau Taumis, James heau Atheas, nau Simon Zenautes haseadagu,
text_for_embed: Luke 6:15 — Matthew, nau Taumis, James heau Atheas, nau Simon Zenautes haseadagu,

text: Nau Judas James henauhauwauau, nau Judas Iskariot, hanane jea neheaudaunade Hejavaneauthusaun.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:16 — Nau Judas James henauhauwauau, nau Judas Iskariot, hanane jea neheaudaunade Hejavaneauthusaun.

text: Nau haejenauunethauna nau haetheaugunauau hethauauwuu, nau hadauchunanenethe hethauguhādaunau, nau haevasenauthenanedau henanedanede hehethee vahee Judea nau Dādaunedan, nau hehethee sasethauwu hadajee Tyre nau Sidon hethāejenauujaathehādaunau, nau haudnenayauhāthee hedasauwauvahedaunenau;
text_for_embed: Luke 6:17 — Nau haejenauunethauna nau haetheaugunauau hethauauwuu, nau hadauchunanenethe hethauguhādaunau, nau haevasenauthenanedau henanedanede hehethee vahee Judea nau Dādaunedan, nau hehethee sasethauwu hadajee Tyre nau Sidon hethāejenauujaathehādaunau, nau haudnenayauhāthee hedasauwauvahedaunenau;

text: Nau hathāenaunauthauwauvahethee wauchāhenethe haujaunau: nau haeenayauhaunauau,
text_for_embed: Luke 6:18 — Nau hathāenaunauthauwauvahethee wauchāhenethe haujaunau: nau haeenayauhaunauau,

text: Nau haunauude hadauchaa haevadauvasanau hanau daunudesanaunee hevadaude nau haevahenayauha.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:19 — Nau haunauude hadauchaa haevadauvasanau hanau daunudesanaunee hevadaude nau haevahenayauha.

text: Nau hanaāenāauhauwaude hethauguhādaunau, Hauwunaunana nananena hadavenuhunena; hanau nananena najanede Hejavaneauthau, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:20 — Nau hanaāenāauhauwaude hethauguhādaunau, Hauwunaunana nananena hadavenuhunena; hanau nananena najanede Hejavaneauthau, hathauhuk.

text: Hauwunaunana nananena hathāasenana hewaunehaa: hanau nananena hadnegaudana. Hauwunaunana nananena hathāevewauhuna hewaunehaa, hanau nananena hadnauchaunena.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:21 — Hauwunaunana nananena hathāasenana hewaunehaa: hanau nananena hadnegaudana. Hauwunaunana nananena hathāevewauhuna hewaunehaa, hanau nananena hadnauchaunena.

text: Hauwunaunana nananena, henaneda hasānavānā, nau jaasauaunānā, nau naunaunauthevānā, nau hausāgudenauthe haneseedaunenau hadauwausaunee, haugau Henane Heāhene heee.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:22 — Hauwunaunana nananena, henaneda hasānavānā, nau jaasauaunānā, nau naunaunauthevānā, nau hausāgudenauthe haneseedaunenau hadauwausaunee, haugau Henane Heāhene heee.

text: Haunauwuthajauau henee hesee heee, nau jajanauauau heee haunauwuthajaude: hanau, naune, hanavanasauau hadaugautheavadenenau hejavaa: hanau naneesedauyaugaune henesaunaunenau naneesehauhaugaunee haeyāhehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:23 — Haunauwuthajauau henee hesee heee, nau jajanauauau heee haunauwuthajaude: hanau, naune, hanavanasauau hadaugautheavadenenau hejavaa: hanau naneesedauyaugaune henesaunaunenau naneesehauhaugaunee haeyāhehau.

text: Hau naunauthauau hadnauauchaudaune hathāeveaunauaune; haugau hanesedanauwuna hauwauthenaedede.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:24 — Hau naunauthauau hadnauauchaudaune hathāeveaunauaune; haugau hanesedanauwuna hauwauthenaedede.

text: Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna hathāegaudana; haudnasenana. Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna hathāauchaunena hewaunehaa, hadnaudauwuthajauna nau hadvewauhuna.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:25 — Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna hathāegaudana; haudnasenana. Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna hathāauchaunena hewaunehaa, hadnaudauwuthajauna nau hadvewauhuna.

text: Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna, daunhāene vahee henaneda hāethadenee hasenehethānā, hanau henesaunaunenau naneesehauyaugaune jayaudauwaeyāhehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:26 — Naunauthauau hadnauauchaudauna, daunhāene vahee henaneda hāethadenee hasenehethānā, hanau henesaunaunenau naneesehauyaugaune jayaudauwaeyāhehau.

text: Hau hadāedauwunathava nananena hathāenedauvana, Vechauthaa nananena haujauthavenau, heneehaa hasānavādaunenau,
text_for_embed: Luke 6:27 — Hau hadāedauwunathava nananena hathāenedauvana, Vechauthaa nananena haujauthavenau, heneehaa hasānavādaunenau,

text: Hauwunaunaa hāwauwauchuvādaunenau, nau hevevethasaa hāwauwauchuhādaunenau nananena.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:28 — Hauwunaunaa hāwauwauchuvādaunenau, nau hevevethasaa hāwauwauchuhādaunenau nananena.

text: Nau henee haudauauvāde hajāeaunaa nau naugautha venene; nau hedanauaugu nananene hauddu jevaedanau jea naudauguvechude jevaethaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:29 — Nau henee haudauauvāde hajāeaunaa nau naugautha venene; nau hedanauaugu nananene hauddu jevaedanau jea naudauguvechude jevaethaa.

text: Hevenaa daun henaneda hānedauwunādaunenau nananene; nau jeva jaenedauwunaa hedanauwunānagu daun hanetheyaunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:30 — Hevenaa daun henaneda hānedauwunādaunenau nananene; nau jeva jaenedauwunaa hedanauwunānagu daun hanetheyaunenau.

text: Daun hasevathehānaune henaneda hesehānenagu, nechau jenaasehaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:31 — Daun hasevathehānaune henaneda hesehānenagu, nechau jenaasehaude.

text: Hith nananena vechauthaunagu daun havechauthādaunenau nananena, haddusevaveeneva nananena? haugau wauwauchudauhuhauau nechau nevechauthauthee hethāevechauthādaunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:32 — Hith nananena vechauthaunagu daun havechauthādaunenau nananena, haddusevaveeneva nananena? haugau wauwauchudauhuhauau nechau nevechauthauthee hethāevechauthādaunenau.

text: Nau hith nananena hethadāgu hasehaunā daun hāneneehādaunenau, haddusevaveeneva nananena? hanau naneesedauhaugaunee wauwauchudauhuhauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:33 — Nau hith nananena hethadāgu hasehaunā daun hāneneehādaunenau, haddusevaveeneva nananena? hanau naneesedauhaugaunee wauwauchudauhuhauau.

text: Nau hith nananena hehaunagu daun hāneejauaunaudaunādaunenau, haddusevaveeneva? hanau wauwauchudauhuhauau nechau neehauhaugaunee wauwauchudauhuhau, hadnejanaasesedanuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:34 — Nau hith nananena hehaunagu daun hāneejauaunaudaunādaunenau, haddusevaveeneva? hanau wauwauchudauhuhauau nechau neehauhaugaunee wauwauchudauhuhau, hadnejanaasesedanuu.

text: Hau vechauthaa nananena haujauthavenau, nau hethadeha hasedauna, nau hehānagu, jevajavathehāe; nau nananena haudaugautheavadenenau hadvasauau, nau nananena hadnaāedāeyaunenena Javaājauuthee: nau neneneehaude nethāejevaveenenethe nau hauhauganau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:35 — Hau vechauthaa nananena haujauthavenau, nau hethadeha hasedauna, nau hehānagu, jevajavathehāe; nau nananena haudaugautheavadenenau hadvasauau, nau nananena hadnaāedāeyaunenena Javaājauuthee: nau neneneehaude nethāejevaveenenethe nau hauhauganau.

text: Hedauwuyaunee nananena, nananena Hāsaunaunenau jea hasedauwuyaunede.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:36 — Hedauwuyaunee nananena, nananena Hāsaunaunenau jea hasedauwuyaunede.

text: Jevaauchuwuu, nau nananene hadnaajauchuwuhane: nau jevaduguthāe nau nananena hadnehauwuduguhuva: hejaegudanauwuyāe nau hadnejaegudanauwunane nananene:
text_for_embed: Luke 6:37 — Jevaauchuwuu, nau nananene hadnaajauchuwuhane: nau jevaduguthāe nau nananena hadnehauwuduguhuva: hejaegudanauwuyāe nau hadnejaegudanauwunane nananene:

text: Vāe, nau hadnevenana nananene, vavesethajauauthāe, dāayāe, nau dāesathāe, nau haunauwauauthāe, hauchauva, henane hadvenāna. Nechau hadnaasethajauaudaunāna hasethajauauthānā hadnanesethajauaudaunana.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:38 — Vāe, nau hadnevenana nananene, vavesethajauauthāe, dāayāe, nau dāesathāe, nau haunauwauauthāe, hauchauva, henane hadvenāna. Nechau hadnaasethajauaudaunāna hasethajauauthānā hadnanesethajauaudaunana.

text: Nau hanaāanadethaude haejejegausuhu, Gaunanenauguhu jenenauājetha nanenauguhu? Gauhaudjenesauujanesenauau gauuhanaa?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:39 — Nau hanaāanadethaude haejejegausuhu, Gaunanenauguhu jenenauājetha nanenauguhu? Gauhaudjenesauujanesenauau gauuhanaa?

text: Thauguthāhe hehauwujavaāhe hechauhauthehādaune: hau haunauude hanesāde daun haunauudaunāde hathāhenith hechauhauthehādaune.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:40 — Thauguthāhe hehauwujavaāhe hechauhauthehādaune: hau haunauude hanesāde daun haunauudaunāde hathāhenith hechauhauthehādaune.

text: Nau naudu hanauhaudauwu nananene hahavaa hejaheede hesesāe, hau haājevesehau havadauhaude hathāsewau hasesāe?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:41 — Nau naudu hanauhaudauwu nananene hahavaa hejaheede hesesāe, hau haājevesehau havadauhaude hathāsewau hasesāe?

text: Wauāthe hauddusenehethau nananene hahavaa, Jāedaā, hadaugauhauwunathe hajaheede hasesāe, hau daujenauhauwaude havadauhaude hathāsewau nehayau hasesāe? Nananene jayaudauwunaedehe, nedauau haugauhune havadauhaude hathāsewau nehayau hasesāe, nau hadenaāeneauvane hadenaāeneaugauhauwu jaheede hethāsathau hahavaa hesesāe.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:42 — Wauāthe hauddusenehethau nananene hahavaa, Jāedaā, hadaugauhauwunathe hajaheede hasesāe, hau daujenauhauwaude havadauhaude hathāsewau nehayau hasesāe? Nananene jayaudauwunaedehe, nedauau haugauhune havadauhaude hathāsewau nehayau hasesāe, nau hadenaāeneauvane hadenaāeneaugauhauwu jaheede hethāsathau hahavaa hesesāe.

text: Hanau hauhaude hethahagu hehauwuseaude wausaunee vevenaudenau; nau wauāthe wauchahagu hauhaude hehauwuseaude hethadenee vevenaudenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:43 — Hanau hauhaude hethahagu hehauwuseaude wausaunee vevenaudenau; nau wauāthe wauchahagu hauhaude hehauwuseaude hethadenee vevenaudenau.

text: Hanau hadauchude hauhaude neaenaunede hanasaunee hevevenaudenau. Hanau hauchahevesee henanenauau hehauwunaadauhauānuu hauuyauchuwunau nau dauchuuwusee hehauwunaadauguunee dadajevenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:44 — Hanau hadauchude hauhaude neaenaunede hanasaunee hevevenaudenau. Hanau hauchahevesee henanenauau hehauwunaadauhauānuu hauuyauchuwunau nau dauchuuwusee hehauwunaadauguunee dadajevenau.

text: Henane hethāde hehethee hethadenee heda nenauuchaudede hethadenee; hau wauchāhede henane wausaunee heda nenauuchaudede wausaunee: hanau waunauthaa hehethee hedahaa hede nanadenaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:45 — Henane hethāde hehethee hethadenee heda nenauuchaudede hethadenee; hau wauchāhede henane wausaunee heda nenauuchaudede wausaunee: hanau waunauthaa hehethee hedahaa hede nanadenaunee.

text: Nau naudu, Vahadāhene, Vahadāhene, haesena, hau nejesedauna hayauhuhau hasenehethathana?
text_for_embed: Luke 6:46 — Nau naudu, Vahadāhene, Vahadāhene, haesena, hau nejesedauna hayauhuhau hasenehethathana?

text: Daun nādasāde nau nedaunānaugu hasenehenaunauau, nau hesedauhuk, haudnauhauthehathana haudnethāde:
text_for_embed: Luke 6:47 — Daun nādasāde nau nedaunānaugu hasenehenaunauau, nau hesedauhuk, haudnauhauthehathana haudnethāde:

text: Henanene henee nenesedenethe hauauwu naathāde, nau henee nejayauchauhuu, nau naneejenanauau hauauwuu dasee hauunaugāe: nau nauunauuu naje neje naunauthuu jaathāsāe henee hauauwuu, nau hehauwunauauvathāau: hanau daunāaudaa hauunaugāe.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:48 — Henanene henee nenesedenethe hauauwu naathāde, nau henee nejayauchauhuu, nau naneejenanauau hauauwuu dasee hauunaugāe: nau nauunauuu naje neje naunauthuu jaathāsāe henee hauauwuu, nau hehauwunauauvathāau: hanau daunāaudaa hauunaugāe.

text: Hau jaathedehe, nau janenaasedauthe, naathāde henanenau henee nedasauauvānethe vedauauwuu; nau neje jaathāsāe naunauthuu, nau nauhauhaunee naunenauauau; nau thauwusāe henee hauauwuu nevasauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 6:49 — Hau jaathedehe, nau janenaasedauthe, naathāde henanenau henee nedasauauvānethe vedauauwuu; nau neje jaathāsāe naunauthuu, nau nauhauhaunee naunenauauau; nau thauwusāe henee hauauwuu nevasauau.

text: Wauhā hāevathanadede vahee hanasenehede daujajaathehade henanedanede, haejedā Capernaum.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:1 — Wauhā hāevathanadede vahee hanasenehede daujajaathehade henanedanede, haejedā Capernaum.

text: Nau jasaa vanenenaja hewauwaune haevechautha haeaugauwune, nau haeyānajane.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:2 — Nau jasaa vanenenaja hewauwaune haevechautha haeaugauwune, nau haeyānajane.

text: Nau hāenedauwauthaude Hejavaneauthusaun, haeautheava vachaugananenau Jews, haeadetha hadjaunith nau hadnenayauhaunith hewauwaune.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:3 — Nau hāenedauwauthaude Hejavaneauthusaun, haeautheava vachaugananenau Jews, haeadetha hadjaunith nau hadnenayauhaunith hewauwaune.

text: Nau hāedauchauthee Hejavaneauthusaun, haeautheauwaunauthasanauau haugaunaunee, hanau hethāde naa henane naa haudneenesedaude, hathauhaugaunee:
text_for_embed: Luke 7:4 — Nau hāedauchauthee Hejavaneauthusaun, haeautheauwaunauthasanauau haugaunaunee, hanau hethāde naa henane naa haudneenesedaude, hathauhaugaunee:

text: Hanau vechaudauau nadedanenau, nau nenesedaunānauau vevethahenauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:5 — Hanau vechaudauau nadedanenau, nau nenesedaunānauau vevethahenauauwuu.

text: Heee Hejavaneauthusau hanaāejasesenethaunāde. Nau hāeauchauau hauauwu, vanenenaja haejajedauaunanenau henedaehauhau, Vahadāhene, jevawauchuthajau Nananene: haugau wauchāhenau hadjedāne naudauauwuu, hathauhuk:
text_for_embed: Luke 7:6 — Heee Hejavaneauthusau hanaāejasesenethaunāde. Nau hāeauchauau hauauwu, vanenenaja haejajedauaunanenau henedaehauhau, Vahadāhene, jevawauchuthajau Nananene: haugau wauchāhenau hadjedāne naudauauwuu, hathauhuk:

text: Nanaa nāejewauchanavadede dauudasathane: hau vavade nehedau hanadede, nau naudautheau hadeenanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:7 — Nanaa nāejewauchanavadede dauudasathane: hau vavade nehedau hanadede, nau naudautheau hadeenanedanede.

text: Hanau nananenau nanethenanenenau naunaudāhenau, nanethenu vanenanenauau, nau naāāedauwunauau hanesāde yehau nau naāejathāaude; nau jasaa, Nahāje, hathauau nau jaunaude; nau naudautheau, Nesede, hathauau, nau nanesedaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:8 — Hanau nananenau nanethenanenenau naunaudāhenau, nanethenu vanenanenauau, nau naāāedauwunauau hanesāde yehau nau naāejathāaude; nau jasaa, Nahāje, hathauau nau jaunaude; nau naudautheau, Nesede, hathauau, nau nanesedaude.

text: Hejavaneauthusau hāenedauwaudauau nuu hayauhuhau, haegaugauanava, nau haenauthegauthaagu, nau hanaāāedauwunaude henanedanau hethāethauguhādaunau, Hadāedauwunathava, Haunauau nāhauwuveehau vasee hethauwuthajuhu (naa hathāde henane), hegau, hehauwuu haduu Israel.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:9 — Hejavaneauthusau hāenedauwaudauau nuu hayauhuhau, haegaugauanava, nau haenauthegauthaagu, nau hanaāāedauwunaude henanedanau hethāethauguhādaunau, Hadāedauwunathava, Haunauau nāhauwuveehau vasee hethauwuthajuhu (naa hathāde henane), hegau, hehauwuu haduu Israel.

text: Nau henee hathāautheavathee, hāejaenuusathee hauauwuu, haeveehanauau wauwaune haeenanedanene henee neasauwauvāhenith.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:10 — Nau henee hathāautheavathee, hāejaenuusathee hauauwuu, haeveehanauau wauwaune haeenanedanene henee neasauwauvāhenith.

text: Nau hethauwuu jasaa hesee, hanaāehaude hedan Nain haseenauyāgu; nau haewauthanenau hethauguhādaunau henethaunādaunau, nau hauwauhuu henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:11 — Nau hethauwuu jasaa hesee, hanaāehaude hedan Nain haseenauyāgu; nau haewauthanenau hethauguhādaunau henethaunādaunau, nau hauwauhuu henanedanede.

text: Wauhā hāayānauusade hejavaaa dajanaunaa hedan, naune, naa najaa henane naunudanade, jasāsau henaune, nau haeenevesānene: nau haewauthane henanedanede hehethee hedan haenethaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:12 — Wauhā hāayānauusade hejavaaa dajanaunaa hedan, naune, naa najaa henane naunudanade, jasāsau henaune, nau haeenevesānene: nau haewauthane henanedanede hehethee hedan haenethaunaa.

text: Nau hāenauhauwaude Vahadāde haeauwunauna, Najenaudāve, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:13 — Nau hāenauhauwaude Vahadāde haeauwunauna, Najenaudāve, hathauhuk.

text: Nau haeedasa nau haevasane nauaunechauthau: nau hethāenauaunechauhādaunau haedādauyaugunenau. Haunaua, hāedauwunathane, Thauwauthe, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:14 — Nau haeedasa nau haevasane nauaunechauthau: nau hethāenauaunechauhādaunau haedādauyaugunenau. Haunaua, hāedauwunathane, Thauwauthe, hathauhuk.

text: Nau henee nenajaa haethauwaudaugu, nau haenaāejasesanadede, nau hanaāevenaude henaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:15 — Nau henee nenajaa haethauwaudaugu, nau haenaāejasesanadede, nau hanaāevenaude henaunene.

text: Nau nāthajaude haeedasā vahee: nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu, Havathee haeyāhe hanejauaude hadedanene; nau, Hejavaneauthau haenauujādauna henesaunau, hahagaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:16 — Nau nāthajaude haeedasā vahee: nau haevaveenethedaunanauau Hejavaneauthu, Havathee haeyāhe hanejauaude hadedanene; nau, Hejavaneauthau haenauujādauna henesaunau, hahagaunee.

text: Nau nuu dauauthedaunenede haenanadesanaune vahee Judea, nau nanadee gauānee vedauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:17 — Nau nuu dauauthedaunenede haenanadesanaune vahee Judea, nau nanadee gauānee vedauauwuu.

text: Nau hethauguhādaunau Jaun haeauthedaunaa vahee nuu hayauhuhau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:18 — Nau hethauguhādaunau Jaun haeauthedaunaa vahee nuu hayauhuhau.

text: Nau Jaun haeadetha hanesenethe hethauguhādaunau haeyethautheava Hejavaneauthusaun, Gauhanane henee waudaudjaude? nau wauāthe gauhadnaudenauhauwau jasaa?
text_for_embed: Luke 7:19 — Nau Jaun haeadetha hanesenethe hethauguhādaunau haeyethautheava Hejavaneauthusaun, Gauhanane henee waudaudjaude? nau wauāthe gauhadnaudenauhauwau jasaa?

text: Hāedauchauthee henanenauau, Jaun Dusaayāhe janādautheavānauau Nananene, hathauhaugaunee, hanaāenaudedaunauthee, Gauhanane henee waudaudjaude? nau wauāthe gauhadnaudenauhauwau jasaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:20 — Hāedauchauthee henanenauau, Jaun Dusaayāhe janādautheavānauau Nananene, hathauhaugaunee, hanaāenaudedaunauthee, Gauhanane henee waudaudjaude? nau wauāthe gauhadnaudenauhauwau jasaa.

text: Nau vavade hāauchauau haeenayauha haewauthanenau vavavāauhuhau nau havathee haugauwude, nau wauchāhenith haujaun; nau haewauthanenau nanenauguhuhau haevena nauhauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:21 — Nau vavade hāauchauau haeenayauha haewauthanenau vavavāauhuhau nau havathee haugauwude, nau wauchāhenith haujaun; nau haewauthanenau nanenauguhuhau haevena nauhauthau.

text: Hejavaneathusaun hanaāāedauwunāthee, Najajathāauau, nau hadāedauwunauva Jaun hathāhaugaunee, hayewhu hanathauhauthāna nau hathadauvana; hasejaenauhauthāde nanenauguhu, jeneejavesāhe daujavesade, naunaujaunee hedaugauwudaunenau dauuyaudahethee, hayājadāhe daunedauvade, gaujauaudahehe daujaethauwauthede, hadavenuhu hethadenee waunauyaunee dauauthedaunade.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:22 — Hejavaneathusaun hanaāāedauwunāthee, Najajathāauau, nau hadāedauwunauva Jaun hathāhaugaunee, hayewhu hanathauhauthāna nau hathadauvana; hasejaenauhauthāde nanenauguhu, jeneejavesāhe daujavesade, naunaujaunee hedaugauwudaunenau dauuyaudahethee, hayājadāhe daunedauvade, gaujauaudahehe daujaethauwauthede, hadavenuhu hethadenee waunauyaunee dauauthedaunade.

text: Nau hauwunaunade daun najewauchuthajaudaunāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:23 — Nau hauwunaunade daun najewauchuthajaudaunāde.

text: Nau hāejathāaunethe Jaun hedautheaunau, hanaāejasesanadedauau henanedanede hasenaedenethe Jauneau, Hayew nananena haewaunenauhauthaunenau nauaunee? gaugauguyāse daunauauvasee?
text_for_embed: Luke 7:24 — Nau hāejathāaunethe Jaun hedautheaunau, hanaāejasesanadedauau henanedanede hasenaedenethe Jauneau, Hayew nananena haewaunenauhauthaunenau nauaunee? gaugauguyāse daunauauvasee?

text: Hau hayew nananena hāewaunenauhauthaunenau? Gauhenane hedāchaunau hejajehaunenau hedāchaunau? Naune, nethāeneenuhuthee, nau neneenaedethee thanāsee nenauchuwunethe hedauauwunenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:25 — Hau hayew nananena hāewaunenauhauthaunenau? Gauhenane hedāchaunau hejajehaunenau hedāchaunau? Naune, nethāeneenuhuthee, nau neneenaedethee thanāsee nenauchuwunethe hedauauwunenenau.

text: Hau hayew hāewaunenauhauthaunenau? Gauhaeyāhe? Haa, hadāedauwunathava nananena, nau javaāsee haeyāhehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:26 — Hau hayew hāewaunenauhauthaunenau? Gauhaeyāhe? Haa, hadāedauwunathava nananena, nau javaāsee haeyāhehau.

text: Naa nananene, wauthaunesee, Naune, hadjejenanauau Naudautheau hathaaguna, hadnesedaunāna hauvaunenau sayānee Nananena.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:27 — Naa nananene, wauthaunesee, Naune, hadjejenanauau Naudautheau hathaaguna, hadnesedaunāna hauvaunenau sayānee Nananena.

text: Hanau nāedauwunathana, hadedanenau nethāenesaunevāna hesānauau hehauwujavaāse haeyāhe hathāde Jaun Dusaayāhe: hau hena haugajehede hanedauhuk henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu javaāhehuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:28 — Hanau nāedauwunathana, hadedanenau nethāenesaunevāna hesānauau hehauwujavaāse haeyāhe hathāde Jaun Dusaayāhe: hau hena haugajehede hanedauhuk henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu javaāhehuk.

text: Nau vahee henanedanede hathāenedaunāde, nau hauāyāhehauau, hanaāechuwauthethajaudaunauthee Hejavaneauthu, haenethedusaanā dusaayāhew Jauneau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:29 — Nau vahee henanedanede hathāenedaunāde, nau hauāyāhehauau, hanaāechuwauthethajaudaunauthee Hejavaneauthu, haenethedusaanā dusaayāhew Jauneau.

text: Hau Nesethajauhuhauau nau nanavaavehehau yesee nehayau haeausagudenauau hevathehādaunene Hejavaneauthu, haejenethedusaanā (Jauneau).
text_for_embed: Luke 7:30 — Hau Nesethajauhuhauau nau nanavaavehehau yesee nehayau haeausagudenauau hevathehādaunene Hejavaneauthu, haejenethedusaanā (Jauneau).

text: Nau Vahadāde hahagu, Hayew naudneedajenehethau henanedanede nuu henaedede? nau haethahenauthe?
text_for_embed: Luke 7:31 — Nau Vahadāde hahagu, Hayew naudneedajenehethau henanedanede nuu henaedede? nau haethahenauthe?

text: Waude dāeyaunauauau hathahethee theaugunauthe haudaunanauauwuu, nau danadethadethee, nau nanāhethee, Nevadauhana, hau nananena nejevadana; naudauwuthajaudauwunana nananena, hau nejevewauhuna.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:32 — Waude dāeyaunauauau hathahethee theaugunauthe haudaunanauauwuu, nau danadethadethee, nau nanāhethee, Nevadauhana, hau nananena nejevadana; naudauwuthajaudauwunana nananena, hau nejevewauhuna.

text: Hanau denauusade Jaun Dusaayāhe dejevethee jauaujaunau nau deejevanaa vasevenenaje; nau nananena nanethenaude haujaun, nethauna.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:33 — Hanau denauusade Jaun Dusaayāhe dejevethee jauaujaunau nau deejevanaa vasevenenaje; nau nananena nanethenaude haujaun, nethauna.

text: Heau henane daunauusade dauvethede nau dauvanaa; Nauhauvaa naa henane naudaudāhe, nau vasevenenajevanehe, henedaehauhau hauāyāhehau nau wauwauchudauhuhau, nethauna.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:34 — Heau henane daunauusade dauvethede nau dauvanaa; Nauhauvaa naa henane naudaudāhe, nau vasevenenajevanehe, henedaehauhau hauāyāhehau nau wauwauchudauhuhau, nethauna.

text: Hau haeyaude chaunuwuthajaudaunaude vahee hedāeyaunewau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:35 — Hau haeyaude chaunuwuthajaudaunaude vahee hedāeyaunewau.

text: Nau hanesāde Nesethajuhu haeadetha haudjewaunenethevethehevāde, nau haeyehau haejedā Nesethajauhu hedauauwunene, nau haejanaugu hadvethede.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:36 — Nau hanesāde Nesethajuhu haeadetha haudjewaunenethevethehevāde, nau haeyehau haejedā Nesethajauhu hedauauwunene, nau haejanaugu hadvethede.

text: Nau, naune, hesā hedan, haeauhaugane, hāaenaunaude Hejavaneauthusaun daujanaugunith hadvethehenith Nesethajauhu hedauauwunene, haejāchaude jaāvasaa chauayau,
text_for_embed: Luke 7:37 — Nau, naune, hesā hedan, haeauhaugane, hāaenaunaude Hejavaneauthusaun daujanaugunith hadvethehenith Nesethajauhu hedauauwunene, haejāchaude jaāvasaa chauayau,

text: Nau haetheaugu hegauwune heauthene haevewau, nau hanaāejasesahesadede heauthene heee hedejee nau haeheahenauwu heee henethaanene, nau haenedane heauthene, nau haechauane heee chauayau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:38 — Nau haetheaugu hegauwune heauthene haevewau, nau hanaāejasesahesadede heauthene heee hedejee nau haeheahenauwu heee henethaanene, nau haenedane heauthene, nau haechauane heee chauayau.

text: Wauhā Nesethajuhu hāadethaude hāenauhauwaude, haejaevenanadethade, Naa Henane, haeyāheyaugu, hanaenaunaude daunhadāhenith nau daunhathāhenith nuu hesāne hevasanādaune: hanau wauwauchuduhu, hahagu.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:39 — Wauhā Nesethajuhu hāadethaude hāenauhauwaude, haejaevenanadethade, Naa Henane, haeyāheyaugu, hanaenaunaude daunhadāhenith nau daunhathāhenith nuu hesāne hevasanādaune: hanau wauwauchuduhu, hahagu.

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude, Simon, haudnāedauwunathane nananene. Nau hanaāenehethaude, Hechauhauthethāhe, nanehe.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:40 — Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāāedauwunaude, Simon, haudnāedauwunathane nananene. Nau hanaāenehethaude, Hechauhauthethāhe, nanehe.

text: Hena jasaa sayānedanauwuyau haenesenenau hesayānedanauwunādaunau: hanesāhenith yauthaunevadadausauau vāejethā, nau jasaa yauthauyauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:41 — Hena jasaa sayānedanauwuyau haenesenenau hesayānedanauwunādaunau: hanesāhenith yauthaunevadadausauau vāejethā, nau jasaa yauthauyauau.

text: Nau hāeyauhuunee haunaudauhudaunene, haenanethauaunegudanauwuna nesauuu Jeāedauwune, hanaane hevechauthādaune javaānee?
text_for_embed: Luke 7:42 — Nau hāeyauhuunee haunaudauhudaunene, haenanethauaunegudanauwuna nesauuu Jeāedauwune, hanaane hevechauthādaune javaānee?

text: Simon hanaāejaāedauwunaude, Nauchāe nananenith heneehejavaāgudanauwunaune. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene neaenauwu.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:43 — Simon hanaāejaāedauwunaude, Nauchāe nananenith heneehejavaāgudanauwunaune. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene neaenauwu.

text: Nau hanaāeyethaagude hesāne, nau hanaāāedauwunaude Simoneau, Gauhaunauhauwau nananene naa hesā? Nananenau nejedānau haudauauwuu, nananene hāehauwuvene naje heee nauaudau: hau neheahesadede nauaudau heee hedejee, nau neheahenauau henethaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:44 — Nau hanaāeyethaagude hesāne, nau hanaāāedauwunaude Simoneau, Gauhaunauhauwau nananene naa hesā? Nananenau nejedānau haudauauwuu, nananene hāehauwuvene naje heee nauaudau: hau neheahesadede nauaudau heee hedejee, nau neheahenauau henethaa.

text: Nananene hāehauwunedane hau naa hesā hāenauusanaunauau hehauwuthauujenenedane nauaudau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:45 — Nananene hāehauwunedane hau naa hesā hāenauusanaunauau hehauwuthauujenenedane nauaudau.

text: Naudauguhua nauguu javeda nananene hajechauusānene hau naa hesā nechauanauau nauaudau heee chauayau.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:46 — Naudauguhua nauguu javeda nananene hajechauusānene hau naa hesā nechauanauau nauaudau heee chauayau.

text: Naa hāedauwunathane nananene hewauchudaudenau waunauthanee gaunudanauwunade; hanau dauvechauthāde javaānee hau daun vanehaa gaunudanauwunade vavade hasevechauthāde vanehaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:47 — Naa hāedauwunathane nananene hewauchudaudenau waunauthanee gaunudanauwunade; hanau dauvechauthāde javaānee hau daun vanehaa gaunudanauwunade vavade hasevechauthāde vanehaa.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hesāne, nananene hauwauchudaudenau jaegudanauwunane.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:48 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hesāne, nananene hauwauchudaudenau jaegudanauwunane.

text: Nau hethāenedauguvādaunau dauvethehethee hanaāejasesanadethee hegaugauuthajaudenenauau hanaa naa negudanauau wauchudaudenau jea?
text_for_embed: Luke 7:49 — Nau hethāenedauguvādaunau dauvethehethee hanaāejasesanadethee hegaugauuthajaudenenauau hanaa naa negudanauau wauchudaudenau jea?

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hesāne, Nananene hadethauwaudaude henayauhāne nananene; najesa hadnauwauthenesane.
text_for_embed: Luke 7:50 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hesāne, Nananene hadethauwaudaude henayauhāne nananene; najesa hadnauwauthenesane.

text: Nau hethauwuu waunee haejathāau nanadee hadauchanenee hedan nau hajaseehedan, dauaunauthedade nau daunaunauhauthethāde neethajaude waunauyaunee hasaunee henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu: nau vadadauchunesenee haenethaunaa,
text_for_embed: Luke 8:1 — Nau hethauwuu waunee haejathāau nanadee hadauchanenee hedan nau hajaseehedan, dauaunauthedade nau daunaunauhauthethāde neethajaude waunauyaunee hasaunee henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu: nau vadadauchunesenee haenethaunaa,

text: Nau jasaa hesānauau, haeenayauhau dewauchāhenethe haujaunau nau vavavāauhuhauau, Mare haseadagu Magdalene, naunudanavathe nesaudauchu wauchāhenethe haujaunau,
text_for_embed: Luke 8:2 — Nau jasaa hesānauau, haeenayauhau dewauchāhenethe haujaunau nau vavavāauhuhauau, Mare haseadagu Magdalene, naunudanavathe nesaudauchu wauchāhenethe haujaunau,

text: Nau Joanna henene Chuza Herod hadāhevāhe, nau Susanna, nau haewauthanauau hauthauauau, hevenādaunau hethāenetheyaunenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:3 — Nau Joanna henene Chuza Herod hadāhevāhe, nau Susanna, nau haewauthanauau hauthauauau, hevenādaunau hethāenetheyaunenenau.

text: Nau hāeneenawauthaa henanedanede dauauāchaudenee, nau haeedasaa hehethee nanadee hedane, hanaāeanadede jegausauhānee:
text_for_embed: Luke 8:4 — Nau hāeneenawauthaa henanedanede dauauāchaudenee, nau haeedasaa hehethee nanadee hedane, hanaāeanadede jegausauhānee:

text: Jenayāhe haewauneneāgude hejenayaunau: hauthauau haejajanesanau vaunaa; nau haeauguhudaunene, nau neahehauau hejavaa haeaudauvanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:5 — Jenayāhe haewauneneāgude hejenayaunau: hauthauau haejajanesanau vaunaa; nau haeauguhudaunene, nau neahehauau hejavaa haeaudauvanauau.

text: Nau hauthauau haedasegaugauusanau hauunagāe; nau chauchaunu hāeveseuu, haenadadanau, hanau daujenajenee.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:6 — Nau hauthauau haedasegaugauusanau hauunagāe; nau chauchaunu hāeveseuu, haenadadanau, hanau daujenajenee.

text: Nau hauthauau haejajanesanau hegauau dauchuuwusee; nau dauchuuwuse haenauguveseaunau, nau haeajedaunanā.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:7 — Nau hauthauau haejajanesanau hegauau dauchuuwusee; nau dauchuuwuse haenauguveseaunau, nau haeajedaunanā.

text: Nau hauthauau haegaugauusanau dasee hadauuthadee vedauauwuu, nau haeveseaunau, nau haeneeaunau vadadausauau jenayaude. Nau hāenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau, haevasenehe, Daun henaudaununede, nanehanedauvade.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:8 — Nau hauthauau haegaugauusanau dasee hadauuthadee vedauauwuu, nau haeveseaunau, nau haeneeaunau vadadausauau jenayaude. Nau hāenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau, haevasenehe, Daun henaudaununede, nanehanedauvade.

text: Nau hethauguhādaunau haenaudedaunaa, duthanau nuu jegausudede, hathāhuk?
text_for_embed: Luke 8:9 — Nau hethauguhādaunau haenaudedaunaa, duthanau nuu jegausudede, hathāhuk?

text: Nau hahagu, Nananena vanenana haudnaenauwuna jaeyaunau henajanede Hejavaneauthau: hau hauthauauau janegausauhuthee; hadnenauhauthāthee havajenauhaudauwu, nedauvahehauau havajaenauwu.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:10 — Nau hahagu, Nananena vanenana haudnaenauwuna jaeyaunau henajanede Hejavaneauthau: hau hauthauauau janegausauhuthee; hadnenauhauthāthee havajenauhaudauwu, nedauvahehauau havajaenauwu.

text: Wauhā, heyew hasauau jegausudede: Jenayaunau hedenehede Hejavaneauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:11 — Wauhā, heyew hasauau jegausudede: Jenayaunau hedenehede Hejavaneauthau.

text: Henee vaunaa nanathee nenedauvathee; hanaāenauusade haujau, nau nedanauwunāthee hanadede hedahenauau, naseduhuu hethauwuthajauau, nau hadenanedanena.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:12 — Henee vaunaa nanathee nenedauvathee; hanaāenauusade haujau, nau nedanauwunāthee hanadede hedahenauau, naseduhuu hethauwuthajauau, nau hadenanedanena.

text: Henee hauunaugāe nanathee, nanedauvanauthe nesedanuu hanadedaunau nauguu haunauwuthajaude; nau nuu hehauwuthājenenauau, vanehaa nethauwauduu, nau nauauchaudaunauthe vasehadede naneenaunegauhuthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:13 — Henee hauunaugāe nanathee, nanedauvanauthe nesedanuu hanadedaunau nauguu haunauwuthajaude; nau nuu hehauwuthājenenauau, vanehaa nethauwauduu, nau nauauchaudaunauthe vasehadede naneenaunegauhuthee.

text: Nau henee nejajanesāe thauhauthauchauyauau dauchuuwusee nanathee, hanesenedauvanauthe, naneejathāauthee, nau neenadejethathee heee haunaunethaude nau nethauyādahede nau haunauwudaude, heee nuu henaedede, nau hehauwunauuchaudenauau vevenaudenau hadauuyauthaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:14 — Nau henee nejajanesāe thauhauthauchauyauau dauchuuwusee nanathee, hanesenedauvanauthe, naneejathāauthee, nau neenadejethathee heee haunaunethaude nau nethauyādahede nau haunauwudaude, heee nuu henaedede, nau hehauwunauuchaudenauau vevenaudenau hadauuyauthaunee.

text: Hau henee hadauuthadenee vedauauwuu nanathee, hethauvahethee nau hethadenee hedahenau nenedauwauduu hanadedaunau, naunaunedethee, nau nenauuchaudethee vevenaudenau heee jenauwauaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:15 — Hau henee hadauuthadenee vedauauwuu nanathee, hethauvahethee nau hethadenee hedahenau nenedauwauduu hanadedaunau, naunaunedethee, nau nenauuchaudethee vevenaudenau heee jenauwauaunee.

text: Hegau henane, hāesedeauchauuu nauauuthayau, hehauwaugau heee vasenau, nau wauāthe hehauwujenane thānee hauvaa; hau nethānauau nauauuthayau neetheaugunee daun janedāde hadenauhaudauau nauauuthayāgu.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:16 — Hegau henane, hāesedeauchauuu nauauuthayau, hehauwaugau heee vasenau, nau wauāthe hehauwujenane thānee hauvaa; hau nethānauau nauauuthayau neetheaugunee daun janedāde hadenauhaudauau nauauuthayāgu.

text: Hayewhu hehauwuyauthesa, haudjauthasenesehee; wauāthe hayewhu hehauwuyau hadjaenaunee nau hadnejaunauau hauthasauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:17 — Hayewhu hehauwuyauthesa, haudjauthasenesehee; wauāthe hayewhu hehauwuyau hadjaenaunee nau hadnejaunauau hauthasauau.

text: Haunauyauhaudauwuu hanathadauvanā: daun nanethenaude, nananede haudnevenade; nau daunjanenethenaude, nananede haudnedanauwunade daun henetheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 8:18 — Haunauyauhaudauwuu hanathadauvanā: daun nanethenaude, nananede haudnevenade; nau daunjanenethenaude, nananede haudnedanauwunade daun henetheyaunau.

text: Hanaāedasāde henaune nau henethesaunau, nau haejeneedasaa heee dauneethenadedaunenee.
