text_for_embed: Luke 10:14 — Hau hadjavaānanethauauyauau heee Tyre nau Sidon hāenaudedaunadedaunee, javaānee nananena.

text: Nau nananena, Capernaum, hanejanana yesee hejavaa, hadjaejanauhanee yesee hadauveeyauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:15 — Nau nananena, Capernaum, hanejanana yesee hejavaa, hadjaejanauhanee yesee hadauveeyauau.

text: Daun hajaathehādaunenau nananena hadjaathehānau; nau daun hauwauchānavādaunenau nananena haudwauchānavānau; nau daun nauwauchanavāde hadwauchanauwaude najejenanādaune.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:16 — Daun hajaathehādaunenau nananena hadjaathehānau; nau daun hauwauchānavādaunenau nananena haudwauchānavānau; nau daun nauwauchanavāde hadwauchanauwaude najejenanādaune.

text: Nau nesaudausauau haejaenauusanauau nauguu neethajaude, hanaāāedauwunauthee, Vahadāhene, daudause haujaunauau hanechauwauaunaunauau heee nananene haneseede.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:17 — Nau nesaudausauau haejaenauusanauau nauguu neethajaude, hanaāāedauwunauthee, Vahadāhene, daudause haujaunauau hanechauwauaunaunauau heee nananene haneseede.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunāthee, Nenauhauwauau Haujau waude jahagude hasejanesaa hehethee hejavaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:18 — Nau hanaāāedauwunāthee, Nenauhauwauau Haujau waude jahagude hasejanesaa hehethee hejavaa.

text: Naune, Nananenau vanenathana nananena naudahede hadnauguhudaunauna seseyānauau nau hauwauhaudathee, nau nanadee vahee henaudahede haujau: nau hegau hadneaseneva.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:19 — Naune, Nananenau vanenathana nananena naudahede hadnauguhudaunauna seseyānauau nau hauwauhaudathee, nau nanadee vahee henaudahede haujau: nau hegau hadneaseneva.

text: Hau vahee nuu jevaneethajaudauwuu, haujaunauau dauuchauwauaunauna; hau henauthauneneethajauau hanau nananena haneseedaunenau dauwauthaunauhuu hejavaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:20 — Hau vahee nuu jevaneethajaudauwuu, haujaunauau dauuchauwauaunauna; hau henauthauneneethajauau hanau nananena haneseedaunenau dauwauthaunauhuu hejavaa.

text: Hena hāauchauau Hejavaneauthusau haeneethajaune hevadathuwu, nau hanaāenehede, Nananenau vaveenethedaunathane Nananene, Hau Nāchau, Vahadāhene hejavaa nau vedauauwuu, hanau Nananene dauyaudaunaude nuu hayauhuhau hehethee nadaunahehehauau nau hathauwunanenauau, nau hadnauhauthehauva dāeyaunauauau: hethauwuu, Nāsaunau; waude hethadee nananena hasesānenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:21 — Hena hāauchauau Hejavaneauthusau haeneethajaune hevadathuwu, nau hanaāenehede, Nananenau vaveenethedaunathane Nananene, Hau Nāchau, Vahadāhene hejavaa nau vedauauwuu, hanau Nananene dauyaudaunaude nuu hayauhuhau hehethee nadaunahehehauau nau hathauwunanenauau, nau hadnauhauthehauva dāeyaunauauau: hethauwuu, Nāsaunau; waude hethadee nananena hasesānenau.

text: Vahee hayauhuhau vanenānau Nāsaunau: nau hegau henane haenauna hanaadāne Heāhene, vavade Vāsaunau; nau hanaadāne Vāsaunau, vavade Vāa, nau nananede hanaadāne Heāwaune hadnenauhauthehāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:22 — Vahee hayauhuhau vanenānau Nāsaunau: nau hegau henane haenauna hanaadāne Heāhene, vavade Vāsaunau; nau hanaadāne Vāsaunau, vavade Vāa, nau nananede hanaadāne Heāwaune hadnenauhauthehāde.

text: Nau hanaāejaedaugauhauwaude hethauguhādaunau, nau hanaāanadethaude hevenanee, Haunauwuthajaunauha hasesānenau dauhunauhaudauwuna hayauhuhau hānauhauthaunenau:
text_for_embed: Luke 10:23 — Nau hanaāejaedaugauhauwaude hethauguhādaunau, nau hanaāanadethaude hevenanee, Haunauwuthajaunauha hasesānenau dauhunauhaudauwuna hayauhuhau hānauhauthaunenau:

text: Hanau nananenau hāedauwunathana, waunauthathee haeyāhehauau nau nenauchuwuthee nevadaunauhauduu hena hayauhuhau hānauhauthaunenau, hau hehauwuthauunauhaudauwu; nau devadaunedauwauduu hena hayauhuhau hānedauwauthaunenau, hau hehauwunedauwaudauwu.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:24 — Hanau nananenau hāedauwunathana, waunauthathee haeyāhehauau nau nenauchuwuthee nevadaunauhauduu hena hayauhuhau hānauhauthaunenau, hau hehauwuthauunauhaudauwu; nau devadaunedauwauduu hena hayauhuhau hānedauwauthaunenau, hau hehauwunedauwaudauwu.

text: Nau, naune, jasaa nanavaavehe haetheaugu, nau haenaudayādauna, Hechauhauthethāhe, nauddusesedane jethauujenee henaedede? hathauhuk,
text_for_embed: Luke 10:25 — Nau, naune, jasaa nanavaavehe haetheaugu, nau haenaudayādauna, Hechauhauthethāhe, nauddusesedane jethauujenee henaedede? hathauhuk,

text: Hanaāāedauwunāde, Hayew wauthaunesaa nanavaavedaunaa? Hādusasauhaude nananene?
text_for_embed: Luke 10:26 — Hanaāāedauwunāde, Hayew wauthaunesaa nanavaavedaunaa? Hādusasauhaude nananene?

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene hadvechauthau Vahadāde nananene Hejavaneauthau nauguu vahee nananene hadahaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene hadathuvaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene hadāahedaunaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene haugaugauuthajaudenaa; nau nananene hanedaudewau waude nehayau nananene.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:27 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene hadvechauthau Vahadāde nananene Hejavaneauthau nauguu vahee nananene hadahaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene hadathuvaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene hadāahedaunaa, nau nauguu vahee nananene haugaugauuthajaudenaa; nau nananene hanedaudewau waude nehayau nananene.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene hethauvāne: nanehasedaune, nau nananene hadnenaedene.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:28 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nananene hethauvāne: nanehasedaune, nau nananene hadnenaedene.

text: Hau nananede, vanadauchuvanadede, hanaāenehethaude Hejavaneauthusaun, Nau hanaa nanedaudewau? hathauhuk,
text_for_embed: Luke 10:29 — Hau nananede, vanadauchuvanadede, hanaāenehethaude Hejavaneauthusaun, Nau hanaa nanedaudewau? hathauhuk,

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhanāedauwunaude, Jasaa henane haejathāau hehethee Dādaunedan hesee Jericho, nau haeesedanaa havedehehau, haethauwujedaunaa hedāchaunau, nau haeenesenehaa, nau haejathāaunenau, haenauthaa dauhayānajaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:30 — Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhanāedauwunaude, Jasaa henane haejathāau hehethee Dādaunedan hesee Jericho, nau haeesedanaa havedehehau, haethauwujedaunaa hedāchaunau, nau haeenesenehaa, nau haejathāaunenau, haenauthaa dauhayānajaa.

text: Nau haejathedasaa jachau vevethahevahew hehethee: nau hāenauhauvāde, haejavechauthaa gauchuhunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:31 — Nau haejathedasaa jachau vevethahevahew hehethee: nau hāenauhauvāde, haejavechauthaa gauchuhunee.

text: Nau vavade Levite, hāedadauau hadaunith, haeeda sa nau haenāauhauva, nau haejavechautha gauchuhunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:32 — Nau vavade Levite, hāedadauau hadaunith, haeeda sa nau haenāauhauva, nau haejavechautha gauchuhunee.

text: Nau jasaa Samaritan, daujādade, haeedasa hadaunith: nau hāenauhauwaude haeauwunauna,
text_for_embed: Luke 10:33 — Nau jasaa Samaritan, daujādade, haeedasa hadaunith: nau hāenauhauwaude haeauwunauna,

text: Nau haeyehau, nau haedugudauna hadauunesenenith, haeedaunauwuna javeda nau vasevenenaje, nau haedasana nehayau hedauneau, nau haenauuchauha vethehedaunauauwuu, nau haeaunauneha.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:34 — Nau haeyehau, nau haedugudauna hadauunesenenith, haeedaunauwuna javeda nau vasevenenaje, nau haedasana nehayau hedauneau, nau haenauuchauha vethehedaunauauwuu, nau haeaunauneha.

text: Nau daunauganenee hāejathāaude, haeadane hanesanenee hevāejethāwau, nau haevena hadāhevahew, nau hadaunaunehau, hathauhuk; nau daun hasegaujauauthedanānaune jee, hāejaenauusanaune nananenau hadaunaudaunathane nananene.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:35 — Nau daunauganenee hāejathāaude, haeadane hanesanenee hevāejethāwau, nau haevena hadāhevahew, nau hadaunaunehau, hathauhuk; nau daun hasegaujauauthedanānaune jee, hāejaenauusanaune nananenau hadaunaudaunathane nananene.

text: Hayewnau nuu hanasāe, hadeanathaunau, henedaudevādaune henee neesedanāde havedehehau?
text_for_embed: Luke 10:36 — Hayewnau nuu hanasāe, hadeanathaunau, henedaudevādaune henee neesedanāde havedehehau?

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude henee heauwunaunādaune. Hanaāenehethaude Hejavaneauthusau, nau jenaenesedaune nananene.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:37 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude henee heauwunaunādaune. Hanaāenehethaude Hejavaneauthusau, nau jenaenesedaune nananene.

text: Wauhā hethauwuu, daunausujavesathee, haenauusanauau jasaa hajaseehauauwudan: nau jasaa hesā haseagu Martha haejedana hedauauwunin.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:38 — Wauhā hethauwuu, daunausujavesathee, haenauusanauau jasaa hajaseehauauwudan: nau jasaa hesā haseagu Martha haejedana hedauauwunin.

text: Nau haeenahavāe Mare haseeyaugaune, jea haejanaugude Hejavaneauthusaun heauthene, nau haenedauwaude hedanadedaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:39 — Nau haeenahavāe Mare haseeyaugaune, jea haejanaugude Hejavaneauthusaun heauthene, nau haenedauwaude hedanadedaunene.

text: Hau Martha haeedauwauchune dauwauthanee hasedaude, nau haejeedasa, nau hanaāenehethaude, Vahadāhene, gauhajegaudauvanade daujenauthānau nahavaa daunesenesethānau? hāedauwunene hadenedahevānau.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:40 — Hau Martha haeedauwauchune dauwauthanee hasedaude, nau haejeedasa, nau hanaāenehethaude, Vahadāhene, gauhajegaudauvanade daujenauthānau nahavaa daunesenesethānau? hāedauwunene hadenedahevānau.

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhanehethaude, Martha, Martha, nananene haunaunāhene nau dejanethajaudauwu waunauthāe hayauhuhau:
text_for_embed: Luke 10:41 — Nau Hejavaneauthusau hanaāauchuhanehethaude, Martha, Martha, nananene haunaunāhene nau dejanethajaudauwu waunauthāe hayauhuhau:

text: Hau hanesadee hayewhu chaunauguauau: nau Mare hayāchauhauau henee hethadenee hadāde, hehauwuneejathechauhau nauthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 10:42 — Hau hanesadee hayewhu chaunauguauau: nau Mare hayāchauhauau henee hethadenee hadāde, hehauwuneejathechauhau nauthee.

text: Nau hethauwuu, henee, daunausuvevethahede haedaunanenee, hāejenedaude, hanesāhenith hethauguhādaune hathāhuk, Vahadāhene, jeechauhauthehāa hadnesevevethahee, waude Jaun jea neesechauhauthehaude hethauguhādaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:1 — Nau hethauwuu, henee, daunausuvevethahede haedaunanenee, hāejenedaude, hanesāhenith hethauguhādaune hathāhuk, Vahadāhene, jeechauhauthehāa hadnesevevethahee, waude Jaun jea neesechauhauthehaude hethauguhādaunau.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, hāene nananena vanevethahenā jeenanesenehena, Hāsaunaunene Nananede hanedaude hejavaa, Vadanauha Nananene haneseede. Nananene hanajanede hanājaunauau. Nananene hathanavāane hadnaasedaunee hasauau hejavaa, nau jee nuu vedauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:2 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, hāene nananena vanevethahenā jeenanesenehena, Hāsaunaunene Nananede hanedaude hejavaa, Vadanauha Nananene haneseede. Nananene hanajanede hanājaunauau. Nananene hathanavāane hadnaasedaunee hasauau hejavaa, nau jee nuu vedauauwuu.

text: Hejevenāa hadauchusenee hayauwusenee vethewau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:3 — Hejevenāa hadauchusenee hayauwusenee vethewau.

text: Nau jejaegudanauwunāa hewauchudaudenedaunau hanau nechau nejaegudanauwunade haunauude hanesāde nethāesayānedanauwunāade. Nau jevaechauhāa nedauvasehadee; hau haugaunayauhāa hehethee hadau wausauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:4 — Nau jejaegudanauwunāa hewauchudaudenedaunau hanau nechau nejaegudanauwunade haunauude hanesāde nethāesayānedanauwunāade. Nau jevaechauhāa nedauvasehadee; hau haugaunayauhāa hehethee hadau wausauau.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, hanaa nananena hadnenedaehahede, nau hadneyehaude thaudajaa, nau hadethaude, Va, jeehe hanasāe jauaujaunau;
text_for_embed: Luke 11:5 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, hanaa nananena hadnenedaehahede, nau hadneyehaude thaudajaa, nau hadethaude, Va, jeehe hanasāe jauaujaunau;

text: Hanau nādae daunauujādaunānau, nau nananenau haeyauhuunee nauchauwaude?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:6 — Hanau nādae daunauujādaunānau, nau nananenau haeyauhuunee nauchauwaude?

text: Nau hehethee jedauwuu hadnauchuhanehede nau hadnenehede, Jevajanethajuhu: dajanau wauwu haugauhude, nau nanesaunauau nanejauwu naudauvaa; nananenau nāhauwuneethauwauthe nau hajeneevenathane.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:7 — Nau hehethee jedauwuu hadnauchuhanehede nau hadnenehede, Jevajanethajuhu: dajanau wauwu haugauhude, nau nanesaunauau nanejauwu naudauvaa; nananenau nāhauwuneethauwauthe nau hajeneevenathane.

text: Nananenau hāedauwunathana, hadnehauwuthauwauthene nau hadvenāde hanau dauhunedaehāwaude, auhanau dauneenāhede hadthauwauthenith nau hadvenāde daun hadauchuvathehāthe.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:8 — Nananenau hāedauwunathana, hadnehauwuthauwauthene nau hadvenāde hanau dauhunedaehāwaude, auhanau dauneenāhede hadthauwauthenith nau hadvenāde daun hadauchuvathehāthe.

text: Nau nananenau hāedauwunathana, Henedauwauau, nau hadnevenana; henaudethāe, nau hadneveedena; hewaudāhee (dajanau), nau hadnegaunedanauwunana.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:9 — Nau nananenau hāedauwunathana, Henedauwauau, nau hadnevenana; henaudethāe, nau hadneveedena; hewaudāhee (dajanau), nau hadnegaunedanauwunana.

text: Hanau haunauude hanesāde nethāenedauwaude neneaudauwaude; nau henee nenaudethāde neveenauau; nau henee newaudāhaude (dajanaune) hadgaunanauwunade.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:10 — Hanau haunauude hanesāde nethāenedauwaude neneaudauwaude; nau henee nenaudethāde neveenauau; nau henee newaudāhaude (dajanaune) hadgaunanauwunade.

text: Hith hāahenau nedauwunānagu jauaujaunau jasaa nananena henesaunaune, gauhadvenaa hauunaugane? wauāthe nedauwunāhuk nauwu, gauhadvena hauchuhanee gauhadnanene nauwunenith seseyāne?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:11 — Hith hāahenau nedauwunānagu jauaujaunau jasaa nananena henesaunaune, gauhadvenaa hauunaugane? wauāthe nedauwunāhuk nauwu, gauhadvena hauchuhanee gauhadnanene nauwunenith seseyāne?

text: Wauāthe nedauwunāhuk naunau, gauhadvena hauwauhaudanethe?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:12 — Wauāthe nedauwunāhuk naunau, gauhadvena hauwauhaudanethe?

text: Hith nananena, hauhauganenagu, hadaenava hadnesevenauna hethadenee venadedaunau nananena hadāeyaunevenau: duthāee nananena hejavaa Hāsaunaunenau hadvenāva Vadanauwauthauwu nethāenedauwunauna?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:13 — Hith nananena, hauhauganenagu, hadaenava hadnesevenauna hethadenee venadedaunau nananena hadāeyaunevenau: duthāee nananena hejavaa Hāsaunaunenau hadvenāva Vadanauwauthauwu nethāenedauwunauna?

text: Nau neausāguthaude haujaun, nau heehauwanadene. Nau hethauwuu hāejathāaude haujau, hanaāejaanadede; nau henanedanede haegaugauuthajaudene.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:14 — Nau neausāguthaude haujaun, nau heehauwanadene. Nau hethauwuu hāejathāaude haujau, hanaāejaanadede; nau henanedanede haegaugauuthajaudene.

text: Hau jasaa hahagu, Nausāguthaude haujaunau heee Beelzehub najane haujaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:15 — Hau jasaa hahagu, Nausāguthaude haujaunau heee Beelzehub najane haujaunaa.

text: Nau hauthauau, haenaudayādaunaa, haenehethaa hadnauhauthaudenenee hehethee hejavaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:16 — Nau hauthauau, haenaudayādaunaa, haenehethaa hadnauhauthaudenenee hehethee hejavaa.

text: Hau haeaene hedenethajaudenene, haeāedauwuna, Hadauchaa najanede nanayāsenauaugu nehayau hadneyauhuu; nau hauauwuu hasānavadenaugu hauauwuu hadjanesaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:17 — Hau haeaene hedenethajaudenene, haeāedauwuna, Hadauchaa najanede nanayāsenauaugu nehayau hadneyauhuu; nau hauauwuu hasānavadenaugu hauauwuu hadjanesaa.

text: Hith, Haujau jea hasānavadagu, hauddusetheaugune henajanede? hanau nananena denehena nananenau deausāguthaugaunee haujaunauau hehethee Beelzebub.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:18 — Hith, Haujau jea hasānavadagu, hauddusetheaugune henajanede? hanau nananena denehena nananenau deausāguthaugaunee haujaunauau hehethee Beelzebub.

text: Nau hith nananenau hausāguthaugaunee hehethee Beelzebub haujaunauau, hanaa hāahenau hadnausāguthaude? hadedauchuwuwuna.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:19 — Nau hith nananenau hausāguthaugaunee hehethee Beelzebub haujaunauau, hanaa hāahenau hadnausāguthaude? hadedauchuwuwuna.

text: Hau hith nananenau hejadenethedaunaugu Hejavaneauthau hausāguthaugaunee haujaunauau, hethauwuu henajanede Hejavaneauthau hedasāna.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:20 — Hau hith nananenau hejadenethedaunaugu Hejavaneauthau hausāguthaugaunee haujaunauau, hethauwuu henajanede Hejavaneauthau hedasāna.

text: Henane danāahethe hedauchuaunau haunaunedehuk hedauauwuu, hevatheyaunau nedādauyaunee:
text_for_embed: Luke 11:21 — Henane danāahethe hedauchuaunau haunaunedehuk hedauauwuu, hevatheyaunau nedādauyaunee:

text: Hau hāejavaādāāhenethe javaāhehuk hedasāhuk, nau veavehāhaugu, hadnedanauwunāde vahee hedauchuaunau heaanadauwaudenau, nau hadjaanenee hesehaudenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:22 — Hau hāejavaādāāhenethe javaāhehuk hedasāhuk, nau veavehāhaugu, hadnedanauwunāde vahee hedauchuaunau heaanadauwaudenau, nau hadjaanenee hesehaudenau.

text: Daun najenethaunāde hasānavānau: nau daun najenethauāyāvāde naneāsauauwaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:23 — Daun najenethaunāde hasānavānau: nau daun najenethauāyāvāde naneāsauauwaude.

text: Hāenauthauthe wauchāde haujau henanene, nehedesade hadaujenajenenee, denaudedede dauyānusenade; nau janeveedethe, naneenehede, nananenau hadjaesanau naudauauwuu needaujenauahenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:24 — Hāenauthauthe wauchāde haujau henanene, nehedesade hadaujenajenenee, denaudedede dauyānusenade; nau janeveedethe, naneenehede, nananenau hadjaesanau naudauauwuu needaujenauahenau.

text: Nau jaenauusathe, neveedede nesewaudeauhunee nau neyaudauthaunenee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:25 — Nau jaenauusathe, neveedede nesewaudeauhunee nau neyaudauthaunenee.

text: Naeneejathāaude, nau naneedanauwaude hanesaudauchunethe hauthauau haujaunau javaānauhauganenethe javaāhede; nau naneejedāthee, nau nanejanauguthee: nau waunee henee henane naeneejavaānauhauganede nedauaunejeethāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:26 — Naeneejathāaude, nau naneedanauwaude hanesaudauchunethe hauthauau haujaunau javaānauhauganenethe javaāhede; nau naneejedāthee, nau nanejanauguthee: nau waunee henee henane naeneejavaānauhauganede nedauaunejeethāde.

text: Nau hethauwuu, hajeseanadede nuu hayauhuhau, jasaa hesā hehethee henanedaa haevasanade, nau hathauhuk, Hauwunaunade henesaunehe hājanesauthāde Nananene, nau hethanau nedaunenane.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:27 — Nau hethauwuu, hajeseanadede nuu hayauhuhau, jasaa hesā hehethee henanedaa haevasanade, nau hathauhuk, Hauwunaunade henesaunehe hājanesauthāde Nananene, nau hethanau nedaunenane.

text: Hau hahagu, Haa, nausunee, nauwunaunathee nethāejaathededuu hedanadedaunene Hejavaneauthu, nau naunaunedethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:28 — Hau hahagu, Haa, nausunee, nauwunaunathee nethāejaathededuu hedanadedaunene Hejavaneauthu, nau naunaunedethee.

text: Nau henanedanede hāeneenanauthenanedauhuu, hanaāejasesenehede, Nuu nanaa wausauau henaedede: nevadaunauhauthāthee; nau hegau nauhauthaude hadvenaunauau, hau vavade nauhauthau nananede Jonas haeyāhe.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:29 — Nau henanedanede hāeneenanauthenanedauhuu, hanaāejasesenehede, Nuu nanaa wausauau henaedede: nevadaunauhauthāthee; nau hegau nauhauthaude hadvenaunauau, hau vavade nauhauthau nananede Jonas haeyāhe.

text: Hanau Jonas neesenauhauthehaude Ninevites, nechau jea Heau henane hadnaathāde nuu henaedede.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:30 — Hanau Jonas neesenauhauthehaude Ninevites, nechau jea Heau henane hadnaathāde nuu henaedede.

text: Nenauchuwusā janauhuu hadjaegauhāde naudedaunadenesee nauguu henanenau nuu henaedede, nau hadnauthauwuvāna: hanau dejewaunejaathehaude hehethee hāauauvadenee naunaudāhenith Solomon; nau naune, hejavaāhedaune Solomon hanedaunith.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:31 — Nenauchuwusā janauhuu hadjaegauhāde naudedaunadenesee nauguu henanenau nuu henaedede, nau hadnauthauwuvāna: hanau dejewaunejaathehaude hehethee hāauauvadenee naunaudāhenith Solomon; nau naune, hejavaāhedaune Solomon hanedaunith.

text: Henanenauau hehethee Nineveh hadjaegauhāthee naudedaunadenesee nauguu nuu henaedede, nau hadnauthauwuvāna: hanau dauaugauthethajauduu hedauthedaunene Jonas; nau, naune, hejavaāhedaune Jonas hanedaunith.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:32 — Henanenauau hehethee Nineveh hadjaegauhāthee naudedaunadenesee nauguu nuu henaedede, nau hadnauthauwuvāna: hanau dauaugauthethajauduu hedauthedaunene Jonas; nau, naune, hejavaāhedaune Jonas hanedaunith.

text: Hegau henane, hāesedeauchauuu nauauuthayau, hehauwujenane yauthee, daudause hehauwugaudauyauvasenaunaa, hau dasee nauauuthayauneetheaugunee, nethāejedāthee hadnenauhauduu naunauasādanee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:33 — Hegau henane, hāesedeauchauuu nauauuthayau, hehauwujenane yauthee, daudause hehauwugaudauyauvasenaunaa, hau dasee nauauuthayauneetheaugunee, nethāejedāthee hadnenauhauduu naunauasādanee.

text: Hanesenee vadanayannaa nanaa nevasesānee: nanaa hāenesadee hasesānenau nananena, nananene hadnaunauudauyauau hadanayau jea hanechauchaunaa hesee; hau hāene nananene hasesā wausuu, hadanayau jea hadnechauchaunaudene vaneeyauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:34 — Hanesenee vadanayannaa nanaa nevasesānee: nanaa hāenesadee hasesānenau nananena, nananene hadnaunauudauyauau hadanayau jea hanechauchaunaa hesee; hau hāene nananene hasesā wausuu, hadanayau jea hadnechauchaunaudene vaneeyauau.

text: Haunauyauhaudauwauau hanau henee hesee hathāsadaude nananene jeva veeyauha.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:35 — Haunauyauhaudauwauau hanau henee hesee hathāsadaude nananene jeva veeyauha.

text: Hith nananene haunauudauyaugu hadanayau hanau hadnechauchaunaudene hesee, hadnehauwugauuveeyau haunauude hadnechauchaunaa hesee, waude naunauasādāe nauauuthayau nevenāna hesee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:36 — Hith nananene haunauudauyaugu hadanayau hanau hadnechauchaunaudene hesee, hadnehauwugauuveeyau haunauude hadnechauchaunaa hesee, waude naunauasādāe nauauuthayau nevenāna hesee.

text: Nau hajesanadede, jachau Nesethajauhu haeadethaa hadnethevethehewaude: nau haewaunejedā, nau haejanaugu dauvethede.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:37 — Nau hajesanadede, jachau Nesethajauhu haeadethaa hadnethevethehewaude: nau haewaunejedā, nau haejanaugu dauvethede.

text: Nau hāene Nesethajauhu nauhaudauau, haegaudauvanava daujaheseuhunith nedauau hajesejevethehenith.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:38 — Nau hāene Nesethajauhu nauhaudauau, haegaudauvanava daujaheseuhunith nedauau hajesejevethehenith.

text: Nau Vahadāhenith hathāhuk, Hewaunehaa nananena Nesethajauhuhauau neyauthahenauwuna jathee vāenaunau nau saenaunau; hau nananena hethauvaa hanechauchaunaudena vahedayaude nau hauhauganede.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:39 — Nau Vahadāhenith hathāhuk, Hewaunehaa nananena Nesethajauhuhauau neyauthahenauwuna jathee vāenaunau nau saenaunau; hau nananena hethauvaa hanechauchaunaudena vahedayaude nau hauhauganede.

text: Nananena janethauvahena, gaujenane Hejavaneauthau nenesedede jathee gaujee henesede jedauwuu?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:40 — Nananena janethauvahena, gaujenane Hejavaneauthau nenesedede jathee gaujee henesede jedauwuu?

text: Hau hevāe hauwuyau daun hanetheyaunenau; nau, naune, vahee hayauhuhau hadnesewaudeanauwunana?
text_for_embed: Luke 11:41 — Hau hevāe hauwuyau daun hanetheyaunenau; nau, naune, vahee hayauhuhau hadnesewaudeanauwunana?

text: Hau naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena Nesethajauhuhauau, hanau nananena hadvāna vadadauchu wauhaunauau nau naneujaudevejechau nau vahee hathāejajāesuu vejechau, nau hadjavechaudauwuna vavesauchuwude nau devechauthade Hejavaneauthau; nuu hāvachunaasedauna, nau hānanejenaudauwuna hauthauau nejesehee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:42 — Hau naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena Nesethajauhuhauau, hanau nananena hadvāna vadadauchu wauhaunauau nau naneujaudevejechau nau vahee hathāejajāesuu vejechau, nau hadjavechaudauwuna vavesauchuwude nau devechauthade Hejavaneauthau; nuu hāvachunaasedauna, nau hānanejenaudauwuna hauthauau nejesehee.

text: Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena Nesethajauhuhauau, hanau nananena devechaudauwuna najatheaugudaunau jedauwuu vevethahenauauwuu, nau dejachauthana nedauaudaunauvadee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:43 — Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena Nesethajauhuhauau, hanau nananena devechaudauwuna najatheaugudaunau jedauwuu vevethahenauauwuu, nau dejachauthana nedauaudaunauvadee.

text: Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena, wauthaunauhāhehauau nau Nesethajauhuhauau, nanadaunahena, hanau nananena waude nedaugaudauyauhudaunee dejenauhauwuu, nau henanenauau nedasejavesathee hehauwaenaunā.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:44 — Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena, wauthaunauhāhehauau nau Nesethajauhuhauau, nanadaunahena, hanau nananena waude nedaugaudauyauhudaunee dejenauhauwuu, nau henanenauau nedasejavesathee hehauwaenaunā.

text: Hanaāauchuhananadede hanesāde nanavaavehe, nau hathauhuk, Hechauhauthethāhe, nuu dauhanadene nananene naunaunauthevāana jea.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:45 — Hanaāauchuhananadede hanesāde nanavaavehe, nau hathauhuk, Hechauhauthethāhe, nuu dauhanadene nananene naunaunauthevāana jea.

text: Nau hathāhuk naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena jea, nananena nanavaavehehauau, hanau nananena henenauchuna henanenauau nauguu henenauchude hehayaudee javechauhunee, nau nananena nehayau jevavasanauwuu henenauchudaunau heee hanesadee nananena hajadenenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:46 — Nau hathāhuk naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena jea, nananena nanavaavehehauau, hanau nananena henenauchuna henanenauau nauguu henenauchude hehayaudee javechauhunee, nau nananena nehayau jevavasanauwuu henenauchudaunau heee hanesadee nananena hajadenenau.

text: Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena, hanau nananena denesedaunauna gaujauaudahenauauwu haeyāhehauau, nau hāsaunaunenau denauauthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:47 — Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena, hanau nananena denesedaunauna gaujauaudahenauauwu haeyāhehauau, nau hāsaunaunenau denauauthee.

text: Hethauwuu nananena haeyāna henee nananena wauhaunee nanāsedauthee hāsaunaunenau: hanau denauauthee, nau nananena nenesedena hegaujauaudahenauauwunenau,
text_for_embed: Luke 11:48 — Hethauwuu nananena haeyāna henee nananena wauhaunee nanāsedauthee hāsaunaunenau: hanau denauauthee, nau nananena nenesedena hegaujauaudahenauauwunenau,

text: Naasauau jea hahagu hedaeyaude Hejavaneauthau, Hadjenanu haeyāhehauau nau vadauhanauau, nau hauthauau hadnenaathee nau hadnenaunaunauchauthehathee:
text_for_embed: Luke 11:49 — Naasauau jea hahagu hedaeyaude Hejavaneauthau, Hadjenanu haeyāhehauau nau vadauhanauau, nau hauthauau hadnenaathee nau hadnenaunaunauchauthehathee:

text: Henee hevaevenau vahee haeyāhehauau, hanedaunee hehethee davadeesehee vedauauwuu, hadneenaudedauwuhuu nuu henaedede;
text_for_embed: Luke 11:50 — Henee hevaevenau vahee haeyāhehauau, hanedaunee hehethee davadeesehee vedauauwuu, hadneenaudedauwuhuu nuu henaedede;

text: Hehethee hevaevaa Abel nauuu hevaevaa Zacharias henee nenajaa nahethāe jaanaa nau vadannauauwuu: hethauwuu nananenau nehethathana nananena, hadneenaudedauwuhuu nuu heee henaedede.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:51 — Hehethee hevaevaa Abel nauuu hevaevaa Zacharias henee nenajaa nahethāe jaanaa nau vadannauauwuu: hethauwuu nananenau nehethathana nananena, hadneenaudedauwuhuu nuu heee henaedede.

text: Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena nanavaavehehauau, hanau nananena dauhudanauwuna gaunaudauauha haeyaude: nananena hadnehauwujedāva nehayau, nau henee hathāejedāthee nananena najauaunauna.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:52 — Naunauthauau hadnedasāna nananena nanavaavehehauau, hanau nananena dauhudanauwuna gaunaudauauha haeyaude: nananena hadnehauwujedāva nehayau, nau henee hathāejedāthee nananena najauaunauna.

text: Nau daunenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau yesee, wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhauau hanaāejaseseneenanaudedaunāde, nau haeneenadaunanauau hadnauthedaudauwunith hauwauhuu hayauhuhau;
text_for_embed: Luke 11:53 — Nau daunenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau yesee, wauthaunauhāhehau nau Nesethajauhuhauau hanaāejaseseneenanaudedaunāde, nau haeneenadaunanauau hadnauthedaudauwunith hauwauhuu hayauhuhau;

text: Haeaudenauthaa, nau hadnesedanauwunethe hayewhu hehethee hedenene, hadnāedauwauthauthee.
text_for_embed: Luke 11:54 — Haeaudenauthaa, nau hadnesedanauwunethe hayewhu hehethee hedenene, hadnāedauwauthauthee.

text: Gaunauwuu, hāene hena hauāchaudenee hauānee haejedaguu hadauchaa henanedanede, dauwauthaa haeaunauguhudaunadenauau, hanaāejasesāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau nedauau vahee, Haunauyauhaudauwauau nananena gauhaujau Nesethajauhuhauau, nenadaunahethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:1 — Gaunauwuu, hāene hena hauāchaudenee hauānee haejedaguu hadauchaa henanedanede, dauwauthaa haeaunauguhudaunadenauau, hanaāejasesāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau nedauau vahee, Haunauyauhaudauwauau nananena gauhaujau Nesethajauhuhauau, nenadaunahethee.

text: Hanau hehauwuyauthesa, hathāeyauthesaa, daudause hehauwuyauthesa, nethāejaenaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:2 — Hanau hehauwuyauthesa, hathāeyauthesaa, daudause hehauwuyauthesa, nethāejaenaunee.

text: Hanau daun nananena hasanadenā veeyaugu hadnedauwuhuu hesenee; nau henee nananena hasenehenā waunaudaunuu jedauwuu hadnauchunana dasee hauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:3 — Hanau daun nananena hasanadenā veeyaugu hadnedauwuhuu hesenee; nau henee nananena hasenehenā waunaudaunuu jedauwuu hadnauchunana dasee hauauwuu.

text: Nau nananena hāedauwunathana Nādaehauhauau, Jevaesaa henee nenadethee henanedayāhau, nau heee hehauwauthesedaunauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:4 — Nau nananena hāedauwunathana Nādaehauhauau, Jevaesaa henee nenadethee henanedayāhau, nau heee hehauwauthesedaunauau.

text: Hau nananena hāedauwunathana daun nananena hāchaunenau: Hesaa Naa, heee hesenaānagu naunaudāde hadgauusevāna hadaugauhauchanee; haa, Nananenau hāedauwunathana nananena, Hesaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:5 — Hau nananena hāedauwunathana daun nananena hāchaunenau: Hesaa Naa, heee hesenaānagu naunaudāde hadgauusevāna hadaugauhauchanee; haa, Nananenau hāedauwunathana nananena, Hesaa.

text: Hayauthaunethee hajaseaheauau gujeaudaunaune heee hanesāenee nevaāhenee, nau hanesāde hehauwunauneethedaunā Hejavaneauthu?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:6 — Hayauthaunethee hajaseaheauau gujeaudaunaune heee hanesāenee nevaāhenee, nau hanesāde hehauwunauneethedaunā Hejavaneauthu?

text: Hau daudausee hadauchāe hāthaanenau haudauguhuanenau vahenayāee. Jevanāthajauau henaheee: nananena javaānauwauhuana hadauchuthee hajaseaheauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:7 — Hau daudausee hadauchāe hāthaanenau haudauguhuanenau vahenayāee. Jevanāthajauau henaheee: nananena javaānauwauhuana hadauchuthee hajaseaheauau.

text: Jea Nananenau hāedauwunathana, Daun naujaudauthehāde hesee henanedaa, nananede Heāhene henanene jea hadnehauwaudauthehaa hesee hautheaunau Hejavaneauthuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:8 — Jea Nananenau hāedauwunathana, Daun naujaudauthehāde hesee henanedaa, nananede Heāhene henanene jea hadnehauwaudauthehaa hesee hautheaunau Hejavaneauthuu.

text: Hau henee nauyauhāde hesee henanedaa hadneyauhade hathaāhenethe hautheaunau Hejavaneauthuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:9 — Hau henee nauyauhāde hesee henanedaa hadneyauhade hathaāhenethe hautheaunau Hejavaneauthuu.

text: Nau daun hayādaunaude Heāhene henanene, hadjaegudanauwunade: hau nananede henee hauhauganedauau Vadanauwauthauwu hadnehauwujaegudanauwunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:10 — Nau daun hayādaunaude Heāhene henanene, hadjaegudanauwunade: hau nananede henee hauhauganedauau Vadanauwauthauwu hadnehauwujaegudanauwunau.

text: Nau hāejedanānā vevethahenauauwuu, nau hauchuwunanenauau, nau najanauau, jevagaugauanadauwuu wauāthe daunhayewhu nananena hadnesauchuhanehena, wauāthe daun nananena hadnesenehena:
text_for_embed: Luke 12:11 — Nau hāejedanānā vevethahenauauwuu, nau hauchuwunanenauau, nau najanauau, jevagaugauanadauwuu wauāthe daunhayewhu nananena hadnesauchuhanehena, wauāthe daun nananena hadnesenehena:

text: Hanau Vadanauwauthauwu hadnāedauwunāna nauauchaugu daun nananena hadnesenehena.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:12 — Hanau Vadanauwauthauwu hadnāedauwunāna nauauchaugu daun nananena hadnesenehena.

text: Nau hanesāde hehethee hananedaa hathauhuk, Hechauthethāhe, hanadesene nasaa, hadegaugauanauwaunauau vatheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:13 — Nau hanesāde hehethee hananedaa hathauhuk, Hechauthethāhe, hanadesene nasaa, hadegaugauanauwaunauau vatheyaunau.

text: Nau hathāhuk, Henane, hanaa nanesehāde hadnauchuwuhathane nau hadjaanauwunathane nananene?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:14 — Nau hathāhuk, Henane, hanaa nanesehāde hadnauchuwuhathane nau hadjaanauwunathane nananene?

text: Nau hasenehethauhuk, Haunauyauhaudauwauau, nau naseduhuu jevavathehāe: hanau henane hedenaedede hehauwunedahevaa wauthayāgaune hevatheyaunau henetheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:15 — Nau hasenehethauhuk, Haunauyauhaudauwauau, nau naseduhuu jevavathehāe: hanau henane hedenaedede hehauwunedahevaa wauthayāgaune hevatheyaunau henetheyaunau.

text: Nau haeanadetha haejegausudenanadetha, Vedauauwuu jasaa nethauyāsenane haenautheauthā:
text_for_embed: Luke 12:16 — Nau haeanadetha haejegausudenanadetha, Vedauauwuu jasaa nethauyāsenane haenautheauthā:

text: Nau hasethajauhuk nehayau, hewauau hauaudnesedaunaune, hanau hajenethenauwau jedauwuu hadnedauthānauwau navethenau, hahagu?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:17 — Nau hasethajauhuk nehayau, hewauau hauaudnesedaunaune, hanau hajenethenauwau jedauwuu hadnedauthānauwau navethenau, hahagu?

text: Nau hanaāenehede, nuu hadnaasedaunau: hadthauwunauwau nathāyānauauwuu, nau hadnesedenau hadjavaāvasauau; nau hadnaadauthānauwau vahee navethenau nau navatheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:18 — Nau hanaāenehede, nuu hadnaasedaunau: hadthauwunauwau nathāyānauauwuu, nau hadnesedenau hadjavaāvasauau; nau hadnaadauthānauwau vahee navethenau nau navatheyaunau.

text: Nau hadnaāenehethauau navadathuwu, Vadathau, nananene nanethenauwu waunauthāe hanetheyaunau janenanee hadwauthāe jajene; hedanau nanethauaunenaedede, hevethehe, hevaveyā, nau haunauwunaede.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:19 — Nau hadnaāenehethauau navadathuwu, Vadathau, nananene nanethenauwu waunauthāe hanetheyaunau janenanee hadwauthāe jajene; hedanau nanethauaunenaedede, hevethehe, hevaveyā, nau haunauwunaede.

text: Hau Hejavaneauthu hathāhuk, Nananene Hauhauga, nuu dauveeyauau nananene havadathuwu hadnedauwunane: heee hanaa hadnethenauau hajenayaunau?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:20 — Hau Hejavaneauthu hathāhuk, Nananene Hauhauga, nuu dauveeyauau nananene havadathuwu hadnedauwunane: heee hanaa hadnethenauau hajenayaunau?

text: Nananede haenathaunau heveaunauaudenau, nau hehauwuveaunauau hesee Hejavaneauthu.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:21 — Nananede haenathaunau heveaunauaudenau, nau hehauwuveaunauau hesee Hejavaneauthu.

text: Nau hathauhuk hethauguhādaunau, Naa nehethathana, Jevaegaugauanadauwuu hadenaededaunenau, daun hadnevethedaunenau; daudause heee hadanayaunenau, daun hadnāsaunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:22 — Nau hathauhuk hethauguhādaunau, Naa nehethathana, Jevaegaugauanadauwuu hadenaededaunenau, daun hadnevethedaunenau; daudause heee hadanayaunenau, daun hadnāsaunenau.

text: Henaedede javaāsaa vethevaa, nau vadanayau javaāsaa hāchaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:23 — Henaedede javaāsaa vethevaa, nau vadanayau javaāsaa hāchaunaa.

text: Gaugauanavaa huunauau: hanau dejejenayāthee nau dejegauausauhāthee; hehauwunethenauwu thāyānauauwu nau vethewau nedauthāsanenee; nau Hejavaneauthau nauchauwaude: gauhajavaāneenaedeva neahenaa?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:24 — Gaugauanavaa huunauau: hanau dejejenayāthee nau dejegauausauhāthee; hehauwunethenauwu thāyānauauwu nau vethewau nedauthāsanenee; nau Hejavaneauthau nauchauwaude: gauhajavaāneenaedeva neahenaa?

text: Nau hanaa nananena vanadauanāde heee neejahehee?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:25 — Nau hanaa nananena vanadauanāde heee neejahehee?

text: Hith nananena wauhā jeneenesedaunagu henee haugajuhuu, naudu hajanethajaudauwuna hauthauau?
text_for_embed: Luke 12:26 — Hith nananena wauhā jeneenesedaunagu henee haugajuhuu, naudu hajanethajaudauwuna hauthauau?

text: Gaugauanadauwuu nenaugaānuu nejajaesaānuu neseveseuu: hehauwunesethānaunau, hehauwunethaudayānaunau; nau nausunee nāedauwunathana, henee Solomon vahee hevasāthade heehauwunaasenu hasaunee nuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:27 — Gaugauanadauwuu nenaugaānuu nejajaesaānuu neseveseuu: hehauwunesethānaunau, hehauwunethaudayānaunau; nau nausunee nāedauwunathana, henee Solomon vahee hevasāthade heehauwunaasenu hasaunee nuu.

text: Hith wauhā Hejavaneauthau heneenudehuk wauchuunau, nuu desenee nauau, nau naugaagu hadneewaudedaunaunee; hāduthāejavaāvenāva hāchaunau, Hau nananena vanehaa hethauwuthajauna?

text: Hanau vahee nuu neauthudan hathāauauvaa nenaudethāthee: nau nananena Hāsaunaunenau haenauau henee nananena hāvathehādaunenau nuu hayauhuhau.

text: Heaudaunaa henee hanetheyaunenau, nau hauwunaunaa hadavenuhuhauau; jasedauau nesevāejethāwaunau henee nejethauuthauauchusāe, haenathaude haneduu hejavaa henee nejethauuyauhuu, nedaujavedadenee, hehauwujuudenauau nuvanauauau.

text: Nau nanehathahena henanenauau henee nedauyauhauwauthee hanau Hadahethedaunādaunenau, hāejejaesathe hehethee gauwuhaude; henee hāejenauusathe nau hadwaudāhaude, hadgaunanauwunade nauhauhaunee.

text: Hauwunaunaa henee nesethāhehauau nananenethe, Vahadāde hāejenauusathe hadveenaude hadnaunauyauhauthānethe: hethauwāedauwunathana, hadduujede nehayau, nau hadjanauguhaude hadvethehenethe, nau hadjeedauchaude nau hadnaunauchauwaude.

text: Nau hith jenauusahek naneseauwaude haunauyauhauthāhe, wauāthe jenauusahek nanaseauwaude haunauyauhauthāhe, nau hadveenaude hadnesaanunethe, hauwunaunaa henee nesethāhehauau.

text: Nau nuu hāenauwuu, henee hith henane hedauauwuu haenauaugu daun hāauchaunee havedehew neeenauusanith, haunaunauyauhauwaude, nau hanājechuwauthedaunenauhunee hedauauwuu.

text: Nananena hadnaaesaanuna jea, hanau Heau henane hadnauusade daun hāauchaunee hāejenauanauwaunā.

text: Nau Vahadāde hahagu, Hanaa henee chuvahagu nau hesenaedehuk hadāhevāhe, nananede hadāhewaunādaune, hadnevenaude gauuu vethewau nauauchaunee?

text_for_embed: Luke 12:43 — Hauwunaunaa henee nesethāhe, nananenith hadāhewaunādaune hāedasāthe hadveehāde hadnaasehāde.

text: Hethauvaa hathāedauwunathana, henee hadnesehāde hadāhewaude vahee hethāenetheyaunau.

text: Hau nau hith henee nesethāhe hesethajauhuk, Nadāhewaunāde jeguthenauusahek; nau henenesegauhahek henanenau nesethāhehau nau hesānau, nau hevethehagaunee nau hevaveyāhaugaunee, nau henaunauneseavagaunee;
text_for_embed: Luke 12:45 — Hau nau hith henee nesethāhe hesethajauhuk, Nadāhewaunāde jeguthenauusahek; nau henenesegauhahek henanenau nesethāhehau nau hesānau, nau hevethehagaunee nau hevaveyāhaugaunee, nau henaunauneseavagaunee;

text: Hadāhevāhe henee nesethāhe hadnauusanith hajesesenenee hāejejauwuwuhauthe, nau, neeejaenauau, nau hadgudanāde nau hadjenanaude jethauwaudahehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:46 — Hadāhevāhe henee nesethāhe hadnauusanith hajesesenenee hāejejauwuwuhauthe, nau, neeejaenauau, nau hadgudanāde nau hadjenanaude jethauwaudahehau.

text: Nau henee nesethāhe haenauaugu hadāhewaunādaune hathanavāde, nau jesaanuhuk, daudaus dejeesedaude hathanavāthe hadnenenesegauhude dejauaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:47 — Nau henee nesethāhe haenauaugu hadāhewaunādaune hathanavāde, nau jesaanuhuk, daudaus dejeesedaude hathanavāthe hadnenenesegauhude dejauaunee.

text: Hau henee jaenauaugu, nau hesedauhauk neseneneseguhededaunenee hanājauwaunenesegauhude, hanau daun hauwauhuvenāde nananede hadnauwaunedauwunade; nau nananede henane hauwauhauhauthade, nananede hadnauwaunedauwunade.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:48 — Hau henee jaenauaugu, nau hesedauhauk neseneneseguhededaunenee hanājauwaunenesegauhude, hanau daun hauwauhuvenāde nananede hadnauwaunedauwunade; nau nananede henane hauwauhauhauthade, nananede hadnauwaunedauwunade.

text: Hadjejenanauwau heseda dasee vedauauwuu; nau hayew navathehāde wauwu gauhauchagu?

text: Haneejaude hadjenanauau dādaunee vedauauwuu haāthanaveva? hadāedauwunathava, Hegau; hau wauāthe hanāgauanauwau:

text: Henesaunaun hadgauanathee hadnasānauwaude heau, nau heau hadnasānavāde; hesā hadnasānauwaude hedaunau, nau hedaunau hadnasānavāde, hesā hesave hadnasānauwaude, nau hesave hadnasānavāde.

text: Nau hanaāanadedauau jea henanedanede, hāenauhaudauwunā henaunauade jevechauuchaugu hehethee nesenaesade, chauchaunu nananena, Hadnauchuhajauwausauau; nau naenesauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 12:54 — Nau hanaāanadedauau jea henanedanede, hāenauhaudauwunā henaunauade jevechauuchaugu hehethee nesenaesade, chauchaunu nananena, Hadnauchuhajauwausauau; nau naenesauau.

text_for_embed: Luke 13:4 — Wauāthe hena nasaudauchunee, dasee hayauauwuu jedauwuu Siloam dethauwunauauau, nau haenanaā, gaugauanadauwuu henee gauhujavaānauhauganenauau vahee henanedanede henee theaugude jedawuu Dādaunedan?

text: Haeheanade jea nuu dajenehede; Jasaa henane haenethena hauuyauchunauhaudene haejenana jedauwuu dadajevenevese nethauchayaunaa; nau haejenauusa nau haenaunaudede vevenaudenau hanāvenee, hau haejeveede.

text: Hanaāenehethaude nesethāhew hedadajevenevese nethauchayaunaa, Naune, nuu hanasāa jajene nananenau hanejaunau daujenaudedenau vevenaudenau nuu hauuyauchunauhaudee, hau hajeveedenau: dauwauhune; hadevachunauthauyauau vedauauwuu?

text: Nau hanaāauchuhanadethāde, Vahadāhene, hauwaa nanehasene nuu heee jaje jea, nadeesenenesede, nau vehethe hadjenanauwau.

text: Nau, naune hena hesā haujaunehaeheaugauwu nasaudauchunee jajenee, nau haevajanā hauānee, nau haejeneechuwuwauthe nehayau.

text: Nau hāene Hajavaneauthusau nauhauwaude, Haeadetha, nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Hesā, nananene haunaugunane hehethee hadaugauwudaunaa.

text: Nau hauchuwunane vevethahenauauwuu haeauchuhananade nauguu hasenaunaude, hanau henee Hejavaneauthusaun denayauthānith vadanesee, nau haeautheda henanedaa, Hena nanedaudauchāe hese henane heenesethādaunau hanānaneejauna nau hanānaneenayauhana, hau hegau vadanesee.
text_for_embed: Luke 13:14 — Nau hauchuwunane vevethahenauauwuu haeauchuhananade nauguu hasenaunaude, hanau henee Hejavaneauthusaun denayauthānith vadanesee, nau haeautheda henanedaa, Hena nanedaudauchāe hese henane heenesethādaunau hanānaneejauna nau hanānaneenayauhana, hau hegau vadanesee.

text: Vahadāde hanaāauchuhananadethaude, nau hathauhuk, Nananene nanadaunāhene, gauhājene dajee hanesahena vadanesee haugunauva hauwaugajevenau wauāthe naugauchaudaheauau hehethee hewauchuhauchauwauauwuu, nau gāyethaājethauva devanauhauna?
text_for_embed: Luke 13:15 — Vahadāde hanaāauchuhananadethaude, nau hathauhuk, Nananene nanadaunāhene, gauhājene dajee hanesahena vadanesee haugunauva hauwaugajevenau wauāthe naugauchaudaheauau hehethee hewauchuhauchauwauauwuu, nau gāyethaājethauva devanauhauna?

text: Nau gaujenaasaunee naa hesā, hedaunau Ābraham, henee Haujau heduguthaune, naune, nuu nasaudauchunee jajene, hāaugunade hehethee nuu deduguhude vadanesee?
text_for_embed: Luke 13:16 — Nau gaujenaasaunee naa hesā, hedaunau Ābraham, henee Haujau heduguthaune, naune, nuu nasaudauchunee jajene, hāaugunade hehethee nuu deduguhude vadanesee?

text: Nau hāenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau, vahee hejauthauwau haeaudaudāhenenau: nau vahee henanedanede haeneethaujaudene heee vahee havathee hayauhuhau henee hesethaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 13:17 — Nau hāenehedauau nuu hayauhuhau, vahee hejauthauwau haeaudaudāhenenau: nau vahee henanedanede haeneethaujaudene heee vahee havathee hayauhuhau henee hesethaunau.

text: Hanaāenehede, dusaune henajanede Hejavaneauthau? nau hayew naudnenehethau?
text_for_embed: Luke 13:18 — Hanaāenehede, dusaune henajanede Hejavaneauthau? nau hayew naudnenehethau?

text: Waude nejenanenee mausdaude, henane nedanauau, nau neneāgudede hejenayaunaa; nau neveseaudede, nau hāhe haeavadauhaudene; nau neahehauau hejavaa negauusee hedānaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 13:19 — Waude nejenanenee mausdaude, henane nedanauau, nau neneāgudede hejenayaunaa; nau neveseaudede, nau hāhe haeavadauhaudene; nau neahehauau hejavaa negauusee hedānaa.

text: Nau jea hanaāenehede, Hayew naudneedajenehethau henajanede Hejavaneauthau?
text_for_embed: Luke 13:20 — Nau jea hanaāenehede, Hayew naudneedajenehethau henajanede Hejavaneauthau?

text: Waude nesaunauchaa henee hesā nedanauau nau nejenanauau nasau dejenauhunee thauauhanau haunaude devahenesaunadāe.

text: Nau haeehedesa hauwauhauauwudane nau hajasedan, dechauhauthethāde, nau haejāda hesee Dādaunedan.

text: Neaunedauwauau hadejedāna hadaugaugunesāde dajanau: newauthana, Nananenau dāedauwunathana, hadnenaudedena hadnedaujedāna, hau hadnehauwuneedauva.

text: Nau hajauchaugade haenehetha henesaunaune, Nāchau jevene gauuu vatheyaunau henee nāudnedadahedaunau. Nau hanaāgauuvenaude hethāenetheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:12 — Nau hajauchaugade haenehetha henesaunaune, Nāchau jevene gauuu vatheyaunau henee nāudnedadahedaunau. Nau hanaāgauuvenaude hethāenetheyaunau.

text: Nau haunauauhaejewauthanenau hese hajauchaugade hāesauānauau vahee hauānee, nauhanaāejathāaude hesee vavāaune vedauauwuu, nau hena hanaāevadauthedede hethāenetheyaunau heee hauhaugānenaedede.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:13 — Nau haunauauhaejewauthanenau hese hajauchaugade hāesauānauau vahee hauānee, nauhanaāejathāaude hesee vavāaune vedauauwuu, nau hena hanaāevadauthedede hethāenetheyaunau heee hauhaugānenaedede.

text: Nau hāevathedede vahee, hena haanaāenauauchauau naunauthauau hasenaude hena vedauauwuu; nau hanaāadavenuhunede.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:14 — Nau hāevathedede vahee, hena haanaāenauauchauau naunauthauau hasenaude hena vedauauwuu; nau hanaāadavenuhunede.

text: Nau hanaāeyehaude nau hanaāewauhaunesade nehayau hauwauhauauwunanenau henee vedauauwuu; nau haejenanaa hethauauwuu hadnauchauwaude neauthuwauchu.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:15 — Nau hanaāeyehaude nau hanaāewauhaunesade nehayau hauwauhauauwunanenau henee vedauauwuu; nau haejenanaa hethauauwuu hadnauchauwaude neauthuwauchu.

text: Nau hanāneanadauau hanāchauchaunaudede henaude heee jeyauwaunau henee neauthuwauchu hevethedaunenenau: hau hegau henanene hevenaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:16 — Nau hanāneanadauau hanāchauchaunaudede henaude heee jeyauwaunau henee neauthuwauchu hevethedaunenenau: hau hegau henanene hevenaa.

text: Nau hāaenaudede hanaāenehede, Waunauthanethe hedautheaunau nāsaunau nenethenauau jauaujaunau naenedauchanenee nau nejeesesanenee, hau hadnenadaugauyānau?
text_for_embed: Luke 15:17 — Nau hāaenaudede hanaāenehede, Waunauthanethe hedautheaunau nāsaunau nenethenauau jauaujaunau naenedauchanenee nau nejeesesanenee, hau hadnenadaugauyānau?

text: Hadgauhānau nau hadeyehaunau nāsaunau, nau hadnaasenehethauau, Nāchau, nananenau nanethenauwau wauchudaude hesee hayāene, nau yesee nananene,
text_for_embed: Luke 15:18 — Hadgauhānau nau hadeyehaunau nāsaunau, nau hadnaasenehethauau, Nāchau, nananenau nanethenauwau wauchudaude hesee hayāene, nau yesee nananene,

text: Nau nananenau hegau heee hāhauwautheāve: jenesehe waude haudautheaunauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:19 — Nau nananenau hegau heee hāhauwautheāve: jenesehe waude haudautheaunauau.

text: Nau hanaāegauhāde, nau hanaāedauchaude henesaunaune. Hau hajesejedauchaude, henesaunaune haenauhauvaa, nau haeauwunaunaa, nau haeyeseneegau, nau haeanaethesaunaunagutha, nau haenenedana.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:20 — Nau hanaāegauhāde, nau hanaāedauchaude henesaunaune. Hau hajesejedauchaude, henesaunaune haenauhauvaa, nau haeauwunaunaa, nau haeyeseneegau, nau haeanaethesaunaunagutha, nau haenenedana.

text: Nau heau hathāhuk, Nāchau, nananenau nanethenauwau wauchudaude yesee hayāene, nau nananene, nau nananenau hegau hāhauwautheneeāve.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:21 — Nau heau hathāhuk, Nāchau, nananenau nanethenauwau wauchudaude yesee hayāene, nau nananene, nau nananenau hegau hāhauwautheneeāve.

text: Hau henesaunaune hathauyaugaune hedautheaunene, Jādee chaunauguuthadee hu, nau hauyauunaa; nau thānauwunaa nechaunathathau hejadenaa, nau jedauaunenaa:
text_for_embed: Luke 15:22 — Hau henesaunaune hathauyaugaune hedautheaunene, Jādee chaunauguuthadee hu, nau hauyauunaa; nau thānauwunaa nechaunathathau hejadenaa, nau jedauaunenaa:

text: Nau hadjāthauva hede daun gauchujāde wauuu, nau hadnauauva; nau hadvethehenauau, nau hadeaunauwuthajaunauau:
text_for_embed: Luke 15:23 — Nau hadjāthauva hede daun gauchujāde wauuu, nau hadnauauva; nau hadvethehenauau, nau hadeaunauwuthajaunauau:

text: Hanau naa nāa nenajaa, nau jaenaedede; nenaunethauaude, nau jaeveenade; nau hanaāejasesaunauwuthajauthee:
text_for_embed: Luke 15:24 — Hanau naa nāa nenajaa, nau jaenaedede; nenaunethauaude, nau jaeveenade; nau hanaāejasesaunauwuthajauthee:

text: Wauhā vanachauganith heau haeanedaune nauau: nau daunausujaude nau hāayānauusade hedauauwunenau, haenedauwaude haenevaudenene nau haevadaudenene.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:25 — Wauhā vanachauganith heau haeanedaune nauau: nau daunausujaude nau hāayānauusade hedauauwunenau, haenedauwaude haenevaudenene nau haevadaudenene.

text: Nau haeadetha hanesānith haunauaheau, nau haenaudedauna dusedaudene hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:26 — Nau haeadetha hanesānith haunauaheau, nau haenaudedauna dusedaudene hathauhuk.

text: Nau haeāedauwunaa, Nananene hahavaa nauusade; nau nananene hāsaunau naunauaude gauchujānith wauuau, hanau daujaesedanaude nanethauaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:27 — Nau haeāedauwunaa, Nananene hahavaa nauusade; nau nananene hāsaunau naunauaude gauchujānith wauuau, hanau daujaesedanaude nanethauaunee.

text: Nau haeasenauna, nau haejejedā: hanaāejenauahenith henesaunaune, nau haedadadasevaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:28 — Nau haeasenauna, nau haejejedā: hanaāejenauahenith henesaunaune, nau haedadadasevaa.

text: Nau haeauchuhananadetha henesaunaune, Naune, nuu hawauthāe jajenee hāenesedaunathadenau, daudause hāhauwujethauwaudaunathe hanāene hanathauchuwuhunaune: hau haunauau nananene hāhauwuthauuvene haudāsau, henee hanānesedenau haunauwuthajaude nauguu nādaehauhauau:
text_for_embed: Luke 15:29 — Nau haeauchuhananadetha henesaunaune, Naune, nuu hawauthāe jajenee hāenesedaunathadenau, daudause hāhauwujethauwaudaunathe hanāene hanathauchuwuhunaune: hau haunauau nananene hāhauwuthauuvene haudāsau, henee hanānesedenau haunauwuthajaude nauguu nādaehauhauau:

text: Hau chauchaunu hasenauusade naa hāa, hāgaujauauthedaunādaunau hāheenaededaunau heee henesahehau hesānau, nananene hanadaunaude gauchujānith wauuau.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:30 — Hau chauchaunu hasenauusade naa hāa, hāgaujauauthedaunādaunau hāheenaededaunau heee henesahehau hesānau, nananene hanadaunaude gauchujānith wauuau.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, nā, nananene nanethenaedevene, nau vahee henee nāthāenetheyaunau nanehanāhene.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:31 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, nā, nananene nanethenaedevene, nau vahee henee nāthāenetheyaunau nanehanāhene.

text: Dauudasadee henee haneenesehee haunauwuthajaude, nau hadneethajaunee: heee naa hahavaa denajaa, nau jaenaedede; nau denaunethauaude, nau jaeveenade.
text_for_embed: Luke 15:32 — Dauudasadee henee haneenesehee haunauwuthajaude, nau hadneethajaunee: heee naa hahavaa denajaa, nau jaenaedede; nau denaunethauaude, nau jaeveenade.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude jea hethauguhādaunau, hena jasaa haenethauyādā henane, haenethena hadāhevahew; nau haenanene haeauthauwuvaa henee daunethauyādauchudede hevatheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:1 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude jea hethauguhādaunau, hena jasaa haenethauyādā henane, haenethena hadāhevahew; nau haenanene haeauthauwuvaa henee daunethauyādauchudede hevatheyaunau.

text: Nau haeadetha, nau hanaāenaudedaunaude, Duthanee henee daunedaunathane nananene? nayāde hāadāhevadenau hanau nananene hadnehauwuguthadāheva.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:2 — Nau haeadetha, nau hanaāenaudedaunaude, Duthanee henee daunedaunathane nananene? nayāde hāadāhevadenau hanau nananene hadnehauwuguthadāheva.

text: Hadāhevāhe, Hewauau hauaudnesedaunaune? hasethaujauhuk, hanau navahadāhewaunāde haedanauwunānau nadadāhewau: hajeneenauchauhānau; thaununedauwauhunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:3 — Hadāhevāhe, Hewauau hauaudnesedaunaune? hasethaujauhuk, hanau navahadāhewaunāde haedanauwunānau nadadāhewau: hajeneenauchauhānau; thaununedauwauhunenau.

text: Haenauwau hadnesedaunau, henee hāenudanānaune hadāhewaude hadjedanethee hedauauwunenau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:4 — Haenauwau hadnesedaunau, henee hāenudanānaune hadāhewaude hadjedanethee hedauauwunenau.

text: Hanaāadethaude haunauude hadāhewaunādaune hethāesayānedanauwunādaunene, nau hanaāāedauwunaude nanedauwauaunith, Dauhudauchanau hasayānedanauwunaudenau nananene nadāhewaunāde?
text_for_embed: Luke 16:5 — Hanaāadethaude haunauude hadāhewaunādaune hethāesayānedanauwunādaunene, nau hanaāāedauwunaude nanedauwauaunith, Dauhudauchanau hasayānedanauwunaudenau nananene nadāhewaunāde?

text: Nau hāheyaugaune vadadausauau dejenauhuu javeda. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude Hedanau hauwauthaunauha, nau janaugu nauhauhaunee, nau hadwauthaunau yauthauyauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:6 — Nau hāheyaugaune vadadausauau dejenauhuu javeda. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude Hedanau hauwauthaunauha, nau janaugu nauhauhaunee, nau hadwauthaunau yauthauyauau.

text: Hanaāāedauwunaude jachau, nau dauhudauchanau hasayānedayaunau nananene? Nau hanaāāedauwunāde, Vadadausauau dejenauhunee thauauhanewauchuunau. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Hedanau hauwauthaunauha, nau hadwauthaunau nasaudausauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:7 — Hanaāāedauwunaude jachau, nau dauhudauchanau hasayānedayaunau nananene? Nau hanaāāedauwunāde, Vadadausauau dejenauhunee thauauhanewauchuunau. Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Hedanau hauwauthaunauha, nau hadwauthaunau nasaudausauau.

text: Nau vahadāde haevaveenethedauna janechuvāhenith hadāhevahew, hanau dauhaenauau hasedaude: hanau dāeyaunauauau nuu hathāauauvaa hedenaededaunenau hāenuu javaānee hesenedāeyaunauauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:8 — Nau vahadāde haevaveenethedauna janechuvāhenith hadāhevahew, hanau dauhaenauau hasedaude: hanau dāeyaunauauau nuu hathāauauvaa hedenaededaunenau hāenuu javaānee hesenedāeyaunauauau.

text: Nau nananenau hāedauwunathana nesedee nehayau henedaehāvadede heee nethauyādahede hehauwuthade; henee hāejenenaedenā hadeesedanāna nedaujethauujenenaededaunenee.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:9 — Nau nananenau hāedauwunathana nesedee nehayau henedaehāvadede heee nethauyādahede hehauwuthade; henee hāejenenaedenā hadeesedanāna nedaujethauujenenaededaunenee.

text: Henane henee chaunuvāde heee haugajuhuyāgu haneechuvāde jea vasee: nau henane henee janechuvāde vanehaa hehauwuuchuvā jea vanasaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:10 — Henane henee chaunuvāde heee haugajuhuyāgu haneechuvāde jea vasee: nau henane henee janechuvāde vanehaa hehauwuuchuvā jea vanasaunee.

text: Hith naaheene nananena jechuvahena hāhauwuuthaheva nethauyādahede hanaa hadvenāde nananene hadanethaude hethauwuu veaunauaude?
text_for_embed: Luke 16:11 — Hith naaheene nananena jechuvahena hāhauwuuthaheva nethauyādahede hanaa hadvenāde nananene hadanethaude hethauwuu veaunauaude?

text: Nau hith nananena hejechuvahenagu heee henehanahede jasaa henane hanaa hadvenāde nananena henee hanehanahede.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:12 — Nau hith nananena hejechuvahenagu heee henehanahede jasaa henane hanaa hadvenāde nananena henee hanehanahede.

text: Hegau nesethāhe hehauwuneenesedauna hanesenethe hechauhauthethāhehau: jachau hanāasānauwaude hanesāhenith, nau hanāvechauthaude jachau; wauāthe hanādudevede hanesānith, nau hanāthauchaunauhauwaude jachau. Nananena hāhauwuneenesedaunauva Hejavaneauthau nau nethauyādahehehauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:13 — Hegau nesethāhe hehauwuneenesedauna hanesenethe hechauhauthethāhehau: jachau hanāasānauwaude hanesāhenith, nau hanāvechauthaude jachau; wauāthe hanādudevede hanesānith, nau hanāthauchaunauhauwaude jachau. Nananena hāhauwuneenesedaunauva Hejavaneauthau nau nethauyādahehehauau.

text: Nau Nesethajauhuhauau jea, haeveenauwu vāejethā, haenedauwaudauwu vahee nuu hayauhuhau: nau haeauchaudanavanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:14 — Nau Nesethajauhuhauau jea, haeveenauwu vāejethā, haenedauwaudauwu vahee nuu hayauhuhau: nau haeauchaudanavanauau.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude nananena nethadee hasehadenā hathaāhethee henanenauau; hau Hejavaneauthau naenauau hadahenau: hanau henee nechauguanavadethee henanedaa newauchanavathee hathaāhenethe Hejavaneauthu.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:15 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude nananena nethadee hasehadenā hathaāhethee henanenauau; hau Hejavaneauthau naenauau hadahenau: hanau henee nechauguanavadethee henanedaa newauchanavathee hathaāhenethe Hejavaneauthu.

text: Nanavaavedaunau nau haeyāhehauau haunaude nauuu Jaun: heee hena henajanede Hejavaneauthau deheauthedaunee, nau haunauude henanenauau neheeneethenadethee.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:16 — Nanavaavedaunau nau haeyāhehauau haunaude nauuu Jaun: heee hena henajanede Hejavaneauthau deheauthedaunee, nau haunauude henanenauau neheeneethenadethee.

text: Nau hehauwunauthau hejavaa nau vedauauwuu heyauhuāgaune javaānee hanesadee haugajuhuu nanavaavede hadneeyauhuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:17 — Nau hehauwunauthau hejavaa nau vedauauwuu heyauhuāgaune javaānee hanesadee haugajuhuu nanavaavede hadneeyauhuu.

text: Daun hausānaude henene, nau heneyaugu gauchuhunee, wauchudaudehaugauthenenede: nau daun hausāyaune nanewaude wauchudaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:18 — Daun hausānaude henene, nau heneyaugu gauchuhunee, wauchudaudehaugauthenenede: nau daun hausāyaune nanewaude wauchudaude.

text: Hena jasaa nethauyāsenane, haeneenu haevejayaunenau nau haegaugunesaunenau, nau haeneechauna hadauchusenenee:
text_for_embed: Luke 16:19 — Hena jasaa nethauyāsenane, haeneenu haevejayaunenau nau haegaugunesaunenau, nau haeneechauna hadauchusenenee:

text: Nau hena jasaa nedauwuhu Lazarus haseagu, haesaese hedajanaunaa haevahaseva,
text_for_embed: Luke 16:20 — Nau hena jasaa nedauwuhu Lazarus haseagu, haesaese hedajanaunaa haevahaseva,

text: Haevadauugaudaude heee jeyauwaunau nejanesanenee hehethee nethauyāsenanene hevethehedaunene: jea hathave haeedasaa nau haenenesaudauwu hedasewaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:21 — Haevadauugaudaude heee jeyauwaunau nejanesanenee hehethee nethauyāsenanene hevethehedaunene: jea hathave haeedasaa nau haenenesaudauwu hedasewaunau.

text: Nau hethauwuu, henee nedauwuhu haenaja, nau haenauaunechauhaa hautheaunau yesee Abraham haenedauguva: nethauyāsenane jea haenaje, nau haejenanau;
text_for_embed: Luke 16:22 — Nau hethauwuu, henee nedauwuhu haenaja, nau haenauaunechauhaa hautheaunau yesee Abraham haenedauguva: nethauyāsenane jea haenaje, nau haejenanau;

text: Nau hadauveeyaunee haeejenāauguau, haeaudauwuthajau, nau haenauhauva Abraham vavāaune, nau Lazarus haenedauguvane.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:23 — Nau hadauveeyaunee haeejenāauguau, haeaudauwuthajau, nau haenauhauva Abraham vavāaune, nau Lazarus haenedauguvane.

text: Nau haeneduva nau hathauhuk, Nāchau Abraham, jeauwunaune, nau jeautheavene Lazarus, henee hadejegunauhade naunauchuu hejadenaa najee, nau hadedauyauvanauau nāthaune; hanau nananenau hanavachuunau nuu hesedaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:24 — Nau haeneduva nau hathauhuk, Nāchau Abraham, jeauwunaune, nau jeautheavene Lazarus, henee hadejegunauhade naunauchuu hejadenaa najee, nau hadedauyauvanauau nāthaune; hanau nananenau hanavachuunau nuu hesedaa.

text: Hau Abraham hahagu, Nā, hāenau henee nananene deenaedene neesedanauwu neethadee hayauhuhau, nau neesaunee Lazarus neewausaunee hayauhuhau, hau hewaunehaa hauwauthenaedede, hau nananene naunauchauthenaedene.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:25 — Hau Abraham hahagu, Nā, hāenau henee nananene deenaedene neesedanauwu neethadee hayauhuhau, nau neesaunee Lazarus neewausaunee hayauhuhau, hau hewaunehaa hauwauthenaedede, hau nananene naunauchauthenaedene.

text: Nau jea vahee nuu, nahethāe nananee nau nananene haneduu vanasauau vanethaunauau janenanee: hadnejeneehedechaudenee hehethee hede hesee nananene hehauwuneau; daudause hehauwuneejeauchusanauau hadaunee, henee nevadaujauthee hehethee hethaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:26 — Nau jea vahee nuu, nahethāe nananee nau nananene haneduu vanasauau vanethaunauau janenanee: hadnejeneehedechaudenee hehethee hede hesee nananene hehauwuneau; daudause hehauwuneejeauchusanauau hadaunee, henee nevadaujauthee hehethee hethaa.

text: Hanaāenehethaude, Vanevethedaunathane hena heee, Nāchau, henee nananene hadejejenanaude nāsaunau hedauauwuu:
text_for_embed: Luke 16:27 — Hanaāenehethaude, Vanevethedaunathane hena heee, Nāchau, henee nananene hadejejenanaude nāsaunau hedauauwuu:

text: Hanau yaunauthaunethee nauhauwauauau henee hadeāedauwunaude, jea havajaunenau nuu haduu naunauchauthauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:28 — Hanau yaunauthaunethee nauhauwauauau henee hadeāedauwunaude, jea havajaunenau nuu haduu naunauchauthauau.

text: Abraham hanaāāedauwunaude nanethenauthee Mosaseau nau haeyāhehau; jaathehaunauha.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:29 — Abraham hanaāāedauwunaude nanethenauthee Mosaseau nau haeyāhehau; jaathehaunauha.

text: Nau, hegau, nāchau Abraham: hau hith hanesāde jaeyehauhuk hehethee degaujauaudāde, haunaunaunevethajauthee, hathāhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:30 — Nau, hegau, nāchau Abraham: hau hith hanesāde jaeyehauhuk hehethee degaujauaudāde, haunaunaunevethajauthee, hathāhuk.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunāde, Hith jenedaunauhaugaunee Mosaseau nau haeyāhehau, daudause hāhauwuneenadauwaunauau, daudause hanesāhenethe jaegauhāyaugaune hehethee degaujauaudāhenith.
text_for_embed: Luke 16:31 — Nau hanaāāedauwunāde, Hith jenedaunauhaugaunee Mosaseau nau haeyāhehau, daudause hāhauwuneenadauwaunauau, daudause hanesāhenethe jaegauhāyaugaune hehethee degaujauaudāhenith.

text: Hanaāāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau, Hāhauwuneene hau henee dauusenadenau hadnauauchuu: hau naunauthauau hadnauauchaudaude daunjaunaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:1 — Hanaāāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau, Hāhauwuneene hau henee dauusenadenau hadnauauchuu: hau naunauthauau hadnauauchaudaude daunjaunaude.

text: Hanāneene henee thauayānauunaugane henauānauyaugu, nau seāguthadagu hadaje, hauhanāheejegaudauvāhenethe henee haneedauusenanethe jachau nuu hajasedāeyaunauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:2 — Hanāneene henee thauayānauunaugane henauānauyaugu, nau seāguthadagu hadaje, hauhanāheejegaudauvāhenethe henee haneedauusenanethe jachau nuu hajasedāeyaunauau.

text: Haunauyauhaudauwauau nehayau nananena: Hith hahavaenau havawauchuhāva, hadanadethauva; nau hith haunaunevethajauhuk, hadjaegudanauwunauva.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:3 — Haunauyauhaudauwauau nehayau nananena: Hith hahavaenau havawauchuhāva, hadanadethauva; nau hith haunaunevethajauhuk, hadjaegudanauwunauva.

text: Nau hith wauwauchuhānagu nesaudauchu hajesesenenee, nau nesaudauchu hajesesenenee naujaeyethaagudaunānagu, haunaunaunevethajaunau, hethānagu: nananena hadjaegudanauwunauva.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:4 — Nau hith wauwauchuhānagu nesaudauchu hajesesenenee, nau nesaudauchu hajesesenenee naujaeyethaagudaunānagu, haunaunaunevethajaunau, hethānagu: nananena hadjaegudanauwunauva.

text: Nau vadauhanauau, Vahadāhene, hethedaunanauwunāa hedethauwaudaudenede, hathauhaugaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:5 — Nau vadauhanauau, Vahadāhene, hethedaunanauwunāa hedethauwaudaudenede, hathauhaugaunee.

text: Nau Vahadāhenith hathāhaugaunee, Hith nananena hethauwaudauwunagu hethāee hethāuu mausdaude jenayaunau, nananena hanāna nuu segaumau hunauhaudene, Hanāgauchauhana hethājee, nau hanājenanauna hadajee; nau hanāthauwaudaunāna.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:6 — Nau Vahadāhenith hathāhaugaunee, Hith nananena hethauwaudauwunagu hethāee hethāuu mausdaude jenayaunau, nananena hanāna nuu segaumau hunauhaudene, Hanāgauchauhana hethājee, nau hanājenanauna hadajee; nau hanāthauwaudaunāna.

text: Hau hanaa nananena, hanāwauwaunavede hanāthauauauwujethānith wauāthe hananajauānith, hanāthauna waunee hāenauusathe hehethee nauau, Najese nau hadjanaugu nau hadvethe?
text_for_embed: Luke 17:7 — Hau hanaa nananena, hanāwauwaunavede hanāthauauauwujethānith wauāthe hananajauānith, hanāthauna waunee hāenauusathe hehethee nauau, Najese nau hadjanaugu nau hadvethe?

text: Hau hanājenaasenehethauna, Hesetheva nayaudenee hadnevethehenau, nau duujehe nehayau, nau hadjeenechaudaune haunaude hesevethehenaugu nau hesaveyānaugu; nau heauhauwune jenaevethehene nau hadevaveyā?
text_for_embed: Luke 17:8 — Hau hanājenaasenehethauna, Hesetheva nayaudenee hadnevethehenau, nau duujehe nehayau, nau hadjeenechaudaune haunaude hesevethehenaugu nau hesaveyānaugu; nau heauhauwune jenaevethehene nau hadevaveyā?

text: Gauhadvaveene henee wauwau hanau dauhunaasedaude henee hanasenehethāthe? Haunauchāe hegau.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:9 — Gauhadvaveene henee wauwau hanau dauhunaasedaude henee hanasenehethāthe? Haunauchāe hegau.

text: Naathahena, hāene nananena vahesedaunagu hena hayauhuhau hathauchuwuhana, Hāhauwuneejavaājasethānau wauwaunauau; vavade nanesedaunauau hadnesedaunuu, hadeva.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:10 — Naathahena, hāene nananena vahesedaunagu hena hayauhuhau hathauchuwuhana, Hāhauwuneejavaājasethānau wauwaunauau; vavade nanesedaunauau hadnesedaunuu, hadeva.

text: Nau hethauwuu, daunausuyehaude Dādaunedan, haeehedesa nahethāe Samaria nau Gananee.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:11 — Nau hethauwuu, daunausuyehaude Dādaunedan, haeehedesa nahethāe Samaria nau Gananee.

text: Nau hāewaudasade jasaa hauauwudan, haenuchaunaa vadadauchu henanenau haenaujaune hedaugauwudaunenau, haetheaugunenau vavāaune:
text_for_embed: Luke 17:12 — Nau hāewaudasade jasaa hauauwudan, haenuchaunaa vadadauchu henanenau haenaujaune hedaugauwudaunenau, haetheaugunenau vavāaune:

text: Nau haeneduvanauau, nau hanaāenehethauthee, Hejavaneauthusau, Hecauhauthethāhe, jeauwunauāa.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:13 — Nau haeneduvanauau, nau hanaāenehethauthee, Hejavaneauthusau, Hecauhauthethāhe, jeauwunauāa.

text: Nau hāenauhauwaude hanaāāedauwunaude, Waunenauhauthehaa hadanayaunenau vevethahevahehauau. Nau hethauwuu, henee daunausuyehauthee, haejegaudauvāhenauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:14 — Nau hāenauhauwaude hanaāāedauwunaude, Waunenauhauthehaa hadanayaunenau vevethahevahehauau. Nau hethauwuu, henee daunausuyehauthee, haejegaudauvāhenauau.

text: Nau hanesāde, hāenauhaudauau henee dauunayauhade, haejaaagu, nau haevasenehe dauvaveenethedaunaude Hejavaneauthu,
text_for_embed: Luke 17:15 — Nau hanesāde, hāenauhaudauau henee dauunayauhade, haejaaagu, nau haevasenehe dauvaveenethedaunaude Hejavaneauthu,

text: Nau haeuāneseve heauthene, haevaveenethedauna: nau haenaadāde Samaritan.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:16 — Nau haeuāneseve heauthene, haevaveenethedauna: nau haenaadāde Samaritan.

text: Nau Hejavaneauthusaun haeauchuhananadethā, gaujenayauhaunauau vadadauchu? hau daude theaudauchu?
text_for_embed: Luke 17:17 — Nau Hejavaneauthusaun haeauchuhananadethā, gaujenayauhaunauau vadadauchu? hau daude theaudauchu?

text: Hajenauhauvathee hajejaeyehauthee hadvaveenethedaunauthee Hejavaneauthu, vavade naa henewauuhu.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:18 — Hajenauhauvathee hajejaeyehauthee hadvaveenethedaunauthee Hejavaneauthu, vavade naa henewauuhu.

text: Nau haeāedauwuna, Gauhā, najesa: nananene hadethauwaudaude henayauhāne.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:19 — Nau haeāedauwuna, Gauhā, najesa: nananene hadethauwaudaude henayauhāne.

text: Nau hāenaudedaunāde Nesethajauhuhau, daun henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu hadneenauauchaunee, Haeāedauwuna, Henajanede Hejavaneauthau hadnehauwunauauchaune nausujauwuwuhadagu:
text_for_embed: Luke 17:20 — Nau hāenaudedaunāde Nesethajauhuhau, daun henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu hadneenauauchaunee, Haeāedauwuna, Henajanede Hejavaneauthau hadnehauwunauauchaune nausujauwuwuhadagu:

text: Daudause hehedauneagu, Nauhaudauwuu hede, wauāthe, nauhaudauwuu hena, hanau, naune, henajanede Hejavaneauthau thanāsadena,
text_for_embed: Luke 17:21 — Daudause hehedauneagu, Nauhaudauwuu hede, wauāthe, nauhaudauwuu hena, hanau, naune, henajanede Hejavaneauthau thanāsadena,

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau, Hese hadnauauchuu, hāene nananena vadaunauhaudauwunā jasae hese Heau henane, nau hadnehauwunauhaudava.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:22 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude hethauguhādaunau, Hese hadnauauchuu, hāene nananena vadaunauhaudauwunā jasae hese Heau henane, nau hadnehauwunauhaudava.

text: Nau hadnanethāna, Nauhaudau hede; wauāthe nauhaudau hena; jevayehauau, wauāthe jevathauguhaa,
text_for_embed: Luke 17:23 — Nau hadnanethāna, Nauhaudau hede; wauāthe nauhaudau hena; jevayehauau, wauāthe jevathauguhaa,

text: Waude hasauau jahagude, henee naunauasānauuu hehethee naugauthanee naugauauwuu hejavaa neenauasādaa jasaa naugauthanee naugauauwuu hejavaa; hadnaasauau jea Heau henane hadnaasaunee hedeseve.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:24 — Waude hasauau jahagude, henee naunauasānauuu hehethee naugauthanee naugauauwuu hejavaa neenauasādaa jasaa naugauthanee naugauauwuu hejavaa; hadnaasauau jea Heau henane hadnaasaunee hedeseve.

text: Hau nedauau hadnanasenedauau wauthanee, nau hadnausāguthade nuu henaedede.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:25 — Hau nedauau hadnanasenedauau wauthanee, nau hadnausāguthade nuu henaedede.

text: Nau waudeneesaunee deenaedede Noe, hadnaasaunee jea hedeseve Heau henane.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:26 — Nau waudeneesaunee deenaedede Noe, hadnaasaunee jea hedeseve Heau henane.

text: Neauwauthevethehedaune, neauwauthevaveyaudenee, neauwauthenenedaunee, neenenehathee, haunaude nauuu henee Noe dejedāde havathee thewaunaa, nau haenaāenanadauwuauau, nau haenauauhā vahee.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:27 — Neauwauthevethehedaune, neauwauthevaveyaudenee, neauwauthenenedaunee, neenenehathee, haunaude nauuu henee Noe dejedāde havathee thewaunaa, nau haenaāenanadauwuauau, nau haenauauhā vahee.

text: Waudenaasauau jea deenaedede Lot; neauwauthevethehedaunee, neauwauthevaveyaudenee, neauwauthaudaunaudenee, neheaudaunaudenee hayauhuhau, neauwauthejenayaudenee, neauauvadenee;
text_for_embed: Luke 17:28 — Waudenaasauau jea deenaedede Lot; neauwauthevethehedaunee, neauwauthevaveyaudenee, neauwauthaudaunaudenee, neheaudaunaudenee hayauhuhau, neauwauthejenayaudenee, neauauvadenee;

text: Hau hajesesenenee henee Lot haenaude Sodom haeesedanausaude nau haegauhauchanauauhauunauganauau hehethee hejavaa, nau haenauauhā vahee.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:29 — Hau hajesesenenee henee Lot haenaude Sodom haeesedanausaude nau haegauhauchanauauhauunauganauau hehethee hejavaa, nau haenauauhā vahee.

text: Hadnaasauau hesee hāene Heau henane hāenauhauthethāthe.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:30 — Hadnaasauau hesee hāene Heau henane hāenauhauthethāthe.

text: Henee hesee, hāanedauthe dasee hauauwuu, nau hevatheyaunau jedauwuu hauauwuu, nanehajejeauwusade hadejedanauau: nau henee hanedaude nauau, nanehajejejaejaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:31 — Henee hesee, hāanedauthe dasee hauauwuu, nau hevatheyaunau jedauwuu hauauwuu, nanehajejeauwusade hadejedanauau: nau henee hanedaude nauau, nanehajejejaejaude.

text: Dauyuuwuu Lot henene.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:32 — Dauyuuwuu Lot henene.

text: Daun vanadauunayaudede hedenaedede hadnanadede; nau daun hadnanadede hedenaedede hadnenayaudede.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:33 — Daun vanadauunayaudede hedenaedede hadnanadede; nau daun hadnanadede hedenaedede hadnenayaudede.

text: Nananenau nāedauwunathana, henee veeyaugu hadnesethee henanenauau hanesadenee hauau; hanesāde hadnedanade, nau jasaa hadnathauaude,
text_for_embed: Luke 17:34 — Nananenau nāedauwunathana, henee veeyaugu hadnesethee henanenauau hanesadenee hauau; hanesāde hadnedanade, nau jasaa hadnathauaude,

text: Hanesethee hesānauau hadthauayāthee wauhaunee; hanesāde hadnedanade, nau jasaa hadnathauaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:35 — Hanesethee hesānauau hadthauayāthee wauhaunee; hanesāde hadnedanade, nau jasaa hadnathauaude.

text: Hanesethee henanenauau hadnanedauthee nauau; hanesāde hadnedanade nau jasaa hadnathauaude.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:36 — Hanesethee henanenauau hadnanedauthee nauau; hanesāde hadnedanade nau jasaa hadnathauaude.

text: Nau haeauchuhananadethanauau, Daude, Vahadāhene? Nau haeāedauwunā haduu vadanayau, hanaadauhauāneauhuthee neahehauau hauānee.
text_for_embed: Luke 17:37 — Nau haeauchuhananadethanauau, Daude, Vahadāhene? Nau haeāedauwunā haduu vadanayau, hanaadauhauāneauhuthee neahehauau hauānee.

text: Nau haeanadetha hauthaunauhānee nuu heee, hena henane hāvachudajauaunevevetha, nau hājethauujesevenauau;
text_for_embed: Luke 18:1 — Nau haeanadetha hauthaunauhānee nuu heee, hena henane hāvachudajauaunevevetha, nau hājethauujesevenauau;

text: Hahagu haeanedau hedan hauchuwunane, haeejesa Hejavaneauthu, daudause hathauwunanenau:
text_for_embed: Luke 18:2 — Hahagu haeanedau hedan hauchuwunane, haeejesa Hejavaneauthu, daudause hathauwunanenau:

text: Nau haeanedau henevesā hena hedan; nau haejeedasa, Jeaugaunayewhu naujauthavaa, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:3 — Nau haeanedau henevesā hena hedan; nau haejeedasa, Jeaugaunayewhu naujauthavaa, hathauhuk.

text: Nau haejevadaunaasedau: hau waunee hasethajauhuk, hewauāthe nejechauau Hejavaneauthau, nau hathauwunanenau;
text_for_embed: Luke 18:4 — Nau haejevadaunaasedau: hau waunee hasethajauhuk, hewauāthe nejechauau Hejavaneauthau, nau hathauwunanenau;

text: Hau nausunee hanau naa henevesā hajanauchuhānau, hadenayauhauau havaedajauaunejau navanadauchuhaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:5 — Hau nausunee hanau naa henevesā hajanauchuhānau, hadenayauhauau havaedajauaunejau navanadauchuhaa.

text: Nau Vahadāde hasenehehuk, Jaathehaa hasenehede janechuvāhede hauchuwunane.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:6 — Nau Vahadāde hasenehehuk, Jaathehaa hasenehede janechuvāhede hauchuwunane.

text: Nau gauhujavaneauthau gauhadnenayauha nehayau hanayāsanaunau, hauwauaudaunādaunau hesee nau dajāee, hau negudauchuhaude?
text_for_embed: Luke 18:7 — Nau gauhujavaneauthau gauhadnenayauha nehayau hanayāsanaunau, hauwauaudaunādaunau hesee nau dajāee, hau negudauchuhaude?

text: Nananenau nananena nāedauwunathana henee hadnauchuhanenayauhaude, Hau hāejauthe Heau henane, gauhadveede hethauwaudaude nuu hathāauauvaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:8 — Nananenau nananena nāedauwunathana henee hadnauchuhanenayauhaude, Hau hāejauthe Heau henane, gauhadveede hethauwaudaude nuu hathāauauvaa.

text: Nau haeauthaunanadetha jachau nethauwaudaunadenethe nehayau henee dauchuvahethee, nau newauchānauwauthee hauthauau:
text_for_embed: Luke 18:9 — Nau haeauthaunanadetha jachau nethauwaudaunadenethe nehayau henee dauchuvahethee, nau newauchānauwauthee hauthauau:

text: Hanesethee henanenauau haeyehaunauau vevethahenauauwuu hadvevethahethee; hanesāde Nesethajuhu, nau jasaa hauāyāhe.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:10 — Hanesethee henanenauau haeyehaunauau vevethahenauauwuu hadvevethahethee; hanesāde Nesethajuhu, nau jasaa hauāyāhe.

text: Nesethajuhu haetheaugu nau haevevetha waude heee nehayau, Hejavaneauthau, nananenau vaveenethedaunathane, henee nāhauwunaathā hauthauau henanenauau hathahethee, hedanauwuyāhehauau, janechuvahethee, jatheaudauwuyāhehauau, daudause naa hathāde hauāyāhe.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:11 — Nesethajuhu haetheaugu nau haevevetha waude heee nehayau, Hejavaneauthau, nananenau vaveenethedaunathane, henee nāhauwunaathā hauthauau henanenauau hathahethee, hedanauwuyāhehauau, janechuvahethee, jatheaudauwuyāhehauau, daudause naa hathāde hauāyāhe.

text: Nananenau nenaugauyānau nese hanesadee hauchauvadede, Nevānau vadadauchu vahee henee nāthāenetheyaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:12 — Nananenau nenaugauyānau nese hanesadee hauchauvadede, Nevānau vadadauchu vahee henee nāthāenetheyaunau.

text: Nau hauāyāhe haetheaugu vavāaune, daudause haejejenāauguau hejavaa, hau haeanadesejāhede, Hejavaneauthau jeauwunaune wauchudaunau, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:13 — Nau hauāyāhe haetheaugu vavāaune, daudause haejejenāauguau hejavaa, hau haeanadesejāhede, Hejavaneauthau jeauwunaune wauchudaunau, hathauhuk.

text: Nananenau nāedauwunathana, naa henane haejaeyehau hedauauwuu haeauwunaunau haejavaāhe jachau: hanau dathājee hanesāde henee nevadaujavaānajanethee nehayau hadnauwujenanade; nau henee nenehanethaunadede hadnejanade.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:14 — Nananenau nāedauwunathana, naa henane haejaeyehau hedauauwuu haeauwunaunau haejavaāhe jachau: hanau dathājee hanesāde henee nevadaujavaānajanethee nehayau hadnauwujenanade; nau henee nenehanethaunadede hadnejanade.

text: Nau haejādaunanauau jea hajasedāeyaunauau, hadnevasanaude; hau hāenauhaudauwunethe hethauguhādaunau, haeneneuvanauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:15 — Nau haejādaunanauau jea hajasedāeyaunauau, hadnevasanaude; hau hāenauhaudauwunethe hethauguhādaunau, haeneneuvanauau.

text: Hau Hejavaneauthusau haeadetha, nau hahagu, Nanehajauthee hajasedāeyaunauauau, nau jevadauduvaa: naathāhenethe henehanahedaunau henajanede Hejavaneauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:16 — Hau Hejavaneauthusau haeadetha, nau hahagu, Nanehajauthee hajasedāeyaunauauau, nau jevadauduvaa: naathāhenethe henehanahedaunau henajanede Hejavaneauthau.

text: Hethauwuu nāedauwunathana, Daun hadjesedanauau henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu hasenaedenethe hajasedāeyaunauau hadnehauwuneejedā.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:17 — Hethauwuu nāedauwunathana, Daun hadjesedanauau henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu hasenaedenethe hajasedāeyaunauau hadnehauwuneejedā.

text: Nau jachau hauchuwunanene haenaudedaunaa, Hethāhene Hechauhauthethāhe, nauddusedau hadnedanauwau jethauujenenaedede? hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:18 — Nau jachau hauchuwunanene haenaudedaunaa, Hethāhene Hechauhauthethāhe, nauddusedau hadnedanauwau jethauujenenaedede? hathauhuk.

text: Nau Hejavaneauthsaun haeāedauwunaa, Naudu hethāde haesene? henaneda hehauwuthā, vavade hanesāde, nananede, Hejavaneauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:19 — Nau Hejavaneauthsaun haeāedauwunaa, Naudu hethāde haesene? henaneda hehauwuthā, vavade hanesāde, nananede, Hejavaneauthau.

text: Nananene haenauwu nanavaavedaunau, Jevawauchudauau heee haugauthenenede, Jevanaa, Jevaaveda, Jevajayaudauwāedauwauthadee, Vechauchune nananene hāsaunau nau hānau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:20 — Nananene haenauwu nanavaavedaunau, Jevawauchudauau heee haugauthenenede, Jevanaa, Jevaaveda, Jevajayaudauwāedauwauthadee, Vechauchune nananene hāsaunau nau hānau.

text: Nau hanaāenehede, Vahee nuu haunaunedenau heee daujeeseaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:21 — Nau hanaāenehede, Vahee nuu haunaunedenau heee daujeeseaunau.

text: Wauhā Hejavaneauthusau hāenedauwaudauau nuu, Hanaāāedauwunaude, Hanesadee hāhauwusenethene: Vaheaudauna henee hāthāenetheyaunau, nau hadjaanauwunaunauau hadavenuhuhauau, nau nananene hadnethenauwu haenathau hejavaa, nau hadejau hadjethaugu.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:22 — Wauhā Hejavaneauthusau hāenedauwaudauau nuu, Hanaāāedauwunaude, Hanesadee hāhauwusenethene: Vaheaudauna henee hāthāenetheyaunau, nau hadjaanauwunaunauau hadavenuhuhauau, nau nananene hadnethenauwu haenathau hejavaa, nau hadejau hadjethaugu.

text: Nau hāenedauwaudauau nuu, haeaudauwuthajau: hanau deethauwunethauyā dāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:23 — Nau hāenedauwaudauau nuu, haeaudauwuthajau: hanau deethauwunethauyā dāde.

text: Nau Hejavaneauthausaun hāenauhaudauwunith henee dauaudauwuthajaude, Duthāenanauthaune henee nanethenuu veaunauaude hadnesejedāthee henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:24 — Nau Hejavaneauthausaun hāenauhaudauwunith henee dauaudauwuthajaude, Duthāenanauthaune henee nanethenuu veaunauaude hadnesejedāthee henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu, hathauhuk.

text: Hanau hehauwujajathaune heee camel hehedesahagaunee hajasevāhau nedaudaunaudenee, javaāneenauthaunee nethauyāsenane hadnesejedāde henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:25 — Hanau hehauwujajathaune heee camel hehedesahagaunee hajasevāhau nedaudaunaudenee, javaāneenauthaunee nethauyāsenane hadnesejedāde henajanedaunene Hejavaneauthu.

text: Nau hathāenedauwauduu, Hanaa hadnenanedanede? hahagaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:26 — Nau hathāenedauwauduu, Hanaa hadnenanedanede? hahagaunee.

text: Nau hanaāenehenith, hayauhuhau hejethauuneethaunenau henanenauau neneedede Hejavaneauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 18:27 — Nau hanaāenehenith, hayauhuhau hejethauuneethaunenau henanenauau neneedede Hejavaneauthau.

text: Hanaāenehede Peda, Naune, naunaudauwunauau vahee, nau thaunauguhane.
