text: Nau nananena hadnavethevāthee nesauuu hanehānenau, nau hāthesaunenau, nau hādauānenau, nau hādaehahenau; nau jasae nanaena hadneenaana.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:16 — Nau nananena hadnavethevāthee nesauuu hanehānenau, nau hāthesaunenau, nau hādauānenau, nau hādaehahenau; nau jasae nanaena hadneenaana.

text: Nau hadneevahasānavāhena vahee henanedaa hanau naneseede heee.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:17 — Nau hadneevahasānavāhena vahee henanedaa hanau naneseede heee.

text: Hau hegau hāthaanenau haudauguhuanenauau haudnehauwugaujauaudāhenaunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:18 — Hau hegau hāthaanenau haudauguhuanenauau haudnehauwugaujauaudāhenaunau.

text: Hanāedevedaunenau hadnaunaunehaudde havadathuwunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:19 — Hanāedevedaunenau hadnaunaunehaudde havadathuwunau.

text: Nau hāenauhaudauwunā Dādaunedan hadnechauchuaunāna vanenanenauau, nanehāaenauwuna henee nauauhadede wauwu hadneaudaa,
text_for_embed: Luke 21:20 — Nau hāenauhaudauwunā Dādaunedan hadnechauchuaunāna vanenanenauau, nanehāaenauwuna henee nauauhadede wauwu hadneaudaa,

text: Nanehadaugauhuthee hesee hauanee hathāanedauthee Judaea; nau henee hathāanedauthee nahethāe nanehanauahethee; nau jevajejedānauha henee hathāanedauthee gauchuhunee vedauauwuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:21 — Nanehadaugauhuthee hesee hauanee hathāanedauthee Judaea; nau henee hathāanedauthee nahethāe nanehanauahethee; nau jevajejedānauha henee hathāanedauthee gauchuhunee vedauauwuu.

text: Hanau nuu hesee hadneauthedaudenee henee vahee hayauhuhau hathāewauthaunauhuu hadnethauwunaasauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:22 — Hanau nuu hesee hadneauthedaudenee henee vahee hayauhuhau hathāewauthaunauhuu hadnethauwunaasauau.

text: Hau naunauthaunee hadnethauauvāhethee hathāenesaunethee, nau hathāeneaunauhuthee hena hesee, hanau hena hadnavathasenaudenee vedauauwuu, nau hasenaunaudaunāhenauau nuu henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:23 — Hau naunauthaunee hadnethauauvāhethee hathāenesaunethee, nau hathāeneaunauhuthee hena hesee, hanau hena hadnavathasenaudenee vedauauwuu, nau hasenaunaudaunāhenauau nuu henanedanede.

text: Nau hadneaunathāhethee gaugauthau, nau hadnejathechauhāthee hadwauwaunenethee vahee jajaesenanedanede: nau Dādaunedan hadnauguhethee Neauthu, haunaude Neauthu nauauchaudauhaugaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:24 — Nau hadneaunathāhethee gaugauthau, nau hadnejathechauhāthee hadwauwaunenethee vahee jajaesenanedanede: nau Dādaunedan hadnauguhethee Neauthu, haunaude Neauthu nauauchaudauhaugaunee.

text: Nau hadnauhauthaunee hesesee, nau vegusesee, nau hauthuuu; nau nanadee hathāauauvaa hadnaunauādaugauhudaunee jajaesenanedanede, hadnehauwaenauwu; hadaje nau hadnaunaudānaunee;

text: Henanenauau hedahenau hadnadenāthajaunee, nau hanau naunauyauhauduu hena hayauhuhau hadnauauchaunee dasee hathāauauvaa, hanau hathāenauthauau hejavaa hadnauauwunauauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:26 — Henanenauau hedahenau hadnadenāthajaunee, nau hanau naunauyauhauduu hena hayauhuhau hadnauauchaunee dasee hathāauauvaa, hanau hathāenauthauau hejavaa hadnauauwunauauau.

text: Nau hadnaāenauhauwauna Heau henane hadnenauusade henaunauade nauguu naunauthaunee nau hadnavathenauasāauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:27 — Nau hadnaāenauhauwauna Heau henane hadnenauusade henaunauade nauguu naunauthaunee nau hadnavathenauasāauau.

text: Nau hāene nuu hayauhuhau hāenauauchuu, nauhadnaāenaunauānena; nau hadnejenāauguauna heee hadneejaenauthana hadnaāeaudaa.

text: Nau hanaāedadajenehethaude; Nauhauvaa hauuyauchunauhaude, nau vahee hahaudenauau;
text_for_embed: Luke 21:29 — Nau hanaāedadajenehethaude; Nauhauvaa hauuyauchunauhaude, nau vahee hahaudenauau;

text: Hāeguugauāhenauthe, hadnauhauwauna nau hadnaenauwuna nehayau henee veja dauhuaudaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:30 — Hāeguugauāhenauthe, hadnauhauwauna nau hadnaenauwuna nehayau henee veja dauhuaudaa.

text: Hadnaasauau nananena hāenauhaudauwunā nuu hayauhuhau hadnethauwunaasauau, hāenauwuu henee henajanede Hejavaneauthau haneaudanee.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:31 — Hadnaasauau nananena hāenauhaudauwunā nuu hayauhuhau hadnethauwunaasauau, hāenauwuu henee henajanede Hejavaneauthau haneaudanee.

text: Hethauwuu nāedauwunathana, nuu henaedede hadnehauwuvadauau, haunaude vahee hadnethauvāe.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:32 — Hethauwuu nāedauwunathana, nuu henaedede hadnehauwuvadauau, haunaude vahee hadnethauvāe.

text: Hejavaa nau vedauauwuu hadneyauhuu; hau Nadanadedaunau hadnehauwuthauuyauhuunau.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:33 — Hejavaa nau vedauauwuu hadneyauhuu; hau Nadanadedaunau hadnehauwuthauuyauhuunau.

text: Nau haunauyauhaudauwauau nehayau, naseduhuu daunāene hadahenau havaehayaudenau heee haudauhauganedaunenau, nau havanadenenau, nau haunaunethaunenau nuu henaedede, nau henee hesee hadgauduaunāna hau hadnehauwaenava.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:34 — Nau haunauyauhaudauwauau nehayau, naseduhuu daunāene hadahenau havaehayaudenau heee haudauhauganedaunenau, nau havanadenenau, nau haunaunethaunenau nuu henaedede, nau henee hesee hadgauduaunāna hau hadnehauwaenava.

text: Hanau waude nauyaudenau hadnauauchauau vahee hathāetheaugude dasee hathāauauvaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:35 — Hanau waude nauyaudenau hadnauauchauau vahee hathāetheaugude dasee hathāauauvaa.

text: Haunauyauhaudauwauau henaheee, nau hevevethahee dajauaunee, henee nananena hadeheenauguana hadegauchuhuauwuna vahee nuu hayauhuhau henee hadnauauchuu, nau haddetheauguna hathaāhede Heau henane.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:36 — Haunauyauhaudauwauau henaheee, nau hevevethahee dajauaunee, henee nananena hadeheenauguana hadegauchuhuauwuna vahee nuu hayauhuhau henee hadnauauchuu, nau haddetheauguna hathaāhede Heau henane.

text: Nau hesenee haeechauhauthethā vadanauauwuu; nau hāeveeyaunee haenauā, nau haeadāne hauanee henee neseeyāgu hauanee Olives.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:37 — Nau hesenee haeechauhauthethā vadanauauwuu; nau hāeveeyaunee haenauā, nau haeadāne hauanee henee neseeyāgu hauanee Olives.

text: Nau vahee henanedanede haejevanauuchaudene naugusāje daunauganenee hadaude vadannauauwuu, heee dauhujaathehāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 21:38 — Nau vahee henanedanede haejevanauuchaudene naugusāje daunauganenee hadaude vadannauauwuu, heee dauhujaathehāde.

text: Wauhā hadneevasevenee janenesaunauchauanauhuu jauaujaunau haeayānauauchau, Hadavechaude neseāgu.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:1 — Wauhā hadneevasevenee janenesaunauchauanauhuu jauaujaunau haeayānauauchau, Hadavechaude neseāgu.

text: Nau najanau vevethahevahehau nau wauthaunauhāhehauau haegaugauanadauwunenau hadnesenaāde; hau haeedauwu henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:2 — Nau najanau vevethahevahehau nau wauthaunauhāhehauau haegaugauanadauwunenau hadnesenaāde; hau haeedauwu henanedanede.

text: Hanaāejedāde Haujau Judas hejaveede Iscariot, haenethanedau vadadauchunesenee.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:3 — Hanaāejedāde Haujau Judas hejaveede Iscariot, haenethanedau vadadauchunesenee.

text: Nau hanaāejathāaude, nau haeanadetha najanau vevethahevahehau nau haunauyauhauthāhehau, hadneseavedaudaunauwaude.

text: Nau haeneethajaunauau, nau dechauchuwuhadethee hadvenāde vāejethā.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:5 — Nau haeneethajaunauau, nau dechauchuwuhadethee hadvenāde vāejethā.

text: Nau haesayānehetha, nau haeaunauyauhaudauwu hadneeneavedaudaunauwaude henanedanede.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:6 — Nau haesayānehetha, nau haeaunauyauhaudauwu hadneeneavedaudaunauwaude henanedanede.

text: Hanaāenauauchauau hesee janenesaunauchauanauhuu jauaujaunau nanaa hadavechauthau hadnāede.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:7 — Hanaāenauauchauau hesee janenesaunauchauanauhuu jauaujaunau nanaa hadavechauthau hadnāede.

text: Nau hanaāautheawaude Pedaheau nau Jauneau, Najesaa hadesaanudeva hadavechauthadede, hadevethenauau, hathāhaugaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:8 — Nau hanaāautheawaude Pedaheau nau Jauneau, Najesaa hadesaanudeva hadavechauthadede, hadevethenauau, hathāhaugaunee.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunauthee, Daudu hadauvathehāne hadnedauusaanuu?
text_for_embed: Luke 22:9 — Nau hanaāāedauwunauthee, Daudu hadauvathehāne hadnedauusaanuu?

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Naune, hāejedānā hedan, hena henane hadnuchaunāna, hadnewauunauau hauānau hadjaāsanenee naje; hadethauguhauva hauauwuu hadnedaujedāde.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:10 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Naune, hāejedānā hedan, hena henane hadnuchaunāna, hadnewauunauau hauānau hadjaāsanenee naje; hadethauguhauva hauauwuu hadnedaujedāde.

text: Nau hadethauva henane hedauauwunede, Hechauhauthethāhe nejeethāne, daudu jādanauauwuu hadnedauvethenauau hadavechauthadede nauguu nāthauguhādaunauau?
text_for_embed: Luke 22:11 — Nau hadethauva henane hedauauwunede, Hechauhauthethāhe nejeethāne, daudu jādanauauwuu hadnedauvethenauau hadavechauthadede nauguu nāthauguhādaunauau?

text: Nau hadnauhauthehāna vanasaunee dachauauwuu hadnesewaudeanee: hadnesaanuhuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:12 — Nau hadnauhauthehāna vanasaunee dachauauwuu hadnesewaudeanee: hadnesaanuhuu.

text_for_embed: Luke 22:13 — Nau hanaāeyehauthee, nau haeveedenauau neethāedauwunaude: nau hanaāesaanudethee hadavechauthadede.

text_for_embed: Luke 22:14 — Nau hāenauauchaunee, hanaāejanaugude nauguu vadadauchunesenee hevadauhanau.

text_for_embed: Luke 22:15 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, hethauwuvadauvethenau nuu hadavechauthadede naugu nananena hajesejasauwauwuthānau:

text: Hanau nāedauwunathana, Nadnehauwauthevethe nuu, haunaude hadnauauchauau henajanede Hejavaneauthau.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:16 — Hanau nāedauwunathana, Nadnehauwauthevethe nuu, haunaude hadnauauchauau henajanede Hejavaneauthau.

text: Nau hanaāedanauau vāenau, nau hanaāevāde vaveenede, nau hanaāenehede, Hedanauwuu nuu, nau hadjaanauwauva nehayau:
text_for_embed: Luke 22:17 — Nau hanaāedanauau vāenau, nau hanaāevāde vaveenede, nau hanaāenehede, Hedanauwuu nuu, nau hadjaanauwauva nehayau:

text: Hanau nāedauwunathana, Naudnehauwuvanethede dadajevenenaje, hanaude henajanede Hejavaneauthau nauauchauyāgu.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:18 — Hanau nāedauwunathana, Naudnehauwuvanethede dadajevenenaje, hanaude henajanede Hejavaneauthau nauauchauyāgu.

text: Nau hanaāedanauau jauaujau, nau hanaāevade vaveenede, nau haejeane, nau haevena, Nuu nanaa nadanayau havenadenenau: nuu hadneejenauneethedaunena, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:19 — Nau hanaāedanauau jauaujau, nau hanaāevade vaveenede, nau haejeane, nau haevena, Nuu nanaa nadanayau havenadenenau: nuu hadneejenauneethedaunena, hathauhuk.

text: Naasauau jea vāenau hāesethunevethehedaunee, Nuu vāenau waunauyauau hesānaavede Navaevaa, hanedaunauwunana, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:20 — Naasauau jea vāenau hāesethunevethehedaunee, Nuu vāenau waunauyauau hesānaavede Navaevaa, hanedaunauwunana, hathauhuk.

text: Hau nauhauvaa, hejadenaa henee haneavedaudaunade nananenauau nanedauguvānauau vethehedaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:21 — Hau nauhauvaa, hejadenaa henee haneavedaudaunade nananenauau nanedauguvānauau vethehedaunaa.

text: Nau hethauwuu Heau henane hadjathāaude, neesedauwaunade: hau naunauthaunee henee henane haneavedaudaunaudenenee.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:22 — Nau hethauwuu Heau henane hadjathāaude, neesedauwaunade: hau naunauthaunee henee henane haneavedaudaunaudenenee.

text: Nau hanaāenaunaudedaunadethee nehayau, hanaadee hadnesedaude nuu.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:23 — Nau hanaāenaunaudedaunadethee nehayau, hanaadee hadnesedaude nuu.

text: Nau hena jea haeneenayaudenauau, hanaadee hadjavaāvasāthaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:24 — Nau hena jea haeneenayaudenauau, hanaadee hadjavaāvasāthaa.

text: Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nenauchuwuthee Neauthuu haevahadahethedauwu; nau henee nanethenuu naudahede nanadee hesenaedehehauau neseadagaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:25 — Nau hanaāāedauwunaude, Nenauchuwuthee Neauthuu haevahadahethedauwu; nau henee nanethenuu naudahede nanadee hesenaedehehauau neseadagaunee.

text: Hau jevanaathāhee: hau henee havasāthawaunādaunenau, hadenahavaewauva; nau henee naja waude henee henechauthāhehau.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:26 — Hau jevanaathāhee: hau henee havasāthawaunādaunenau, hadenahavaewauva; nau henee naja waude henee henechauthāhehau.

text: Hanaa vanasāthaa, henee vanethede, wauāthe henee henechauthāhe? gaujenane henee vanethede? hau hanedaudaunathana waude henee henechauthāhe.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:27 — Hanaa vanasāthaa, henee vanethede, wauāthe henee henechauthāhe? gaujenane henee vanethede? hau hanedaudaunathana waude henee henechauthāhe.

text: Nananena daudajauaunenethaunena denaunaunauchauthehanau.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:28 — Nananena daudajauaunenethaunena denaunaunauchauthehanau.

text: Nau janenanauwunathana najanede, waude Nāsaunau nejeesejenanauwunānau;
text_for_embed: Luke 22:29 — Nau janenanauwunathana najanede, waude Nāsaunau nejeesejenanauwunānau;

text: Hadevethehena nau hadevaveyāna navethehedaunaa Nanajanedaunaa, nau hadetheaugudauwuna najatheaugudaunau hadnauchuwuhauna vadadauchunesenee jajaesenanedanede Israel.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:30 — Hadevethehena nau hadevaveyāna navethehedaunaa Nanajanedaunaa, nau hadetheaugudauwuna najatheaugudaunau hadnauchuwuhauna vadadauchunesenee jajaesenanedanede Israel.

text: Nau Vahadāde hanaāenehede, Simon, Simon, nauhauwune, Haujau nevadaunethenāne, hadvachuuguthāne waude thauauhanewauchuunau:
text_for_embed: Luke 22:31 — Nau Vahadāde hanaāenehede, Simon, Simon, nauhauwune, Haujau nevadaunethenāne, hadvachuuguthāne waude thauauhanewauchuunau:

text: Hau nevevethasathane, henee hadethauwuthajaude hadejenadegaudenauau: nau hāejauaugauthethajaunaune hadedāewaunauau hahauwauauau.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:32 — Hau nevevethasathane, henee hadethauwuthajaude hadejenadegaudenauau: nau hāejauaugauthethajaunaune hadedāewaunauau hahauwauauau.

text: Nau haenehetha, Vahadāhene, Nananenau hanesaanunau hadnenenethaunathane, nesauna duguhunauauwuu, nau gaujauaudahedaunaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:33 — Nau haenehetha, Vahadāhene, Nananenau hanesaanunau hadnenenethaunathane, nesauna duguhunauauwuu, nau gaujauaudahedaunaa.

text: Nau haeāedauwuna, hāedauwunathane, Peda, neauthuneāhe hadnehauwunedu nuu desenenee, hajesejenehenaune nasau hadnethedauwaune henee nananene daujaenaunene.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:34 — Nau haeāedauwuna, hāedauwunathane, Peda, neauthuneāhe hadnehauwunedu nuu desenenee, hajesejenehenaune nasau hadnethedauwaune henee nananene daujaenaunene.

text: Nau hanaāāedāuwunaude, Deathavejenanathana hāehauwunewauunava nesevāejethāwau, nau newaugusajaānauchu, nau wauaunau, gauhājevathehāva hayewhu? Hegau, hathauhaugaunee.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:35 — Nau hanaāāedāuwunaude, Deathavejenanathana hāehauwunewauunava nesevāejethāwau, nau newaugusajaānauchu, nau wauaunau, gauhājevathehāva hayewhu? Hegau, hathauhaugaunee.

text: Hanaāāedauwunaude, hau hewaunehaa henee nanethenauau nesevāejethāwau nanehaedanauau, nau jea henewaugusajaānauchu; nau henee janenethenauau gaugauchu, nanehaeaudaunade heddu, nau jeaudaunaude gaugauchu.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:36 — Hanaāāedauwunaude, hau hewaunehaa henee nanethenauau nesevāejethāwau nanehaedanauau, nau jea henewaugusajaānauchu; nau henee janenethenauau gaugauchu, nanehaeaudaunade heddu, nau jeaudaunaude gaugauchu.

text: Hanau nāedauwunathana, henee nuu wauthaunauhuu hethauwunaathauthaunauhunau, Nau haewauhaunuau wauwauchudauhuhau: hanau nethauthedauthanau hethauvaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:37 — Hanau nāedauwunathana, henee nuu wauthaunauhuu hethauwunaathauthaunauhunau, Nau haewauhaunuau wauwauchudauhuhau: hanau nethauthedauthanau hethauvaa.

text: Nau hathauhaugaunee, Vahadāhene, nauhaudau, heyewnau hanesāe gaugauthau. Nau haeāedauwuna, Naadauchāe.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:38 — Nau hathauhaugaunee, Vahadāhene, nauhaudau, heyewnau hanesāe gaugauthau. Nau haeāedauwuna, Naadauchāe.

text: Nau haejenaua, nau haejathāau, nesedaude, haua nee Olives; nau hethauguhādaunau jea haethauguhaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:39 — Nau haejenaua, nau haejathāau, nesedaude, haua nee Olives; nau hethauguhādaunau jea haethauguhaa.

text: Nau hāanauusade, haeāedauwuna hevevethahee henee hadejejedāna vasehadede.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:40 — Nau hāanauusade, haeāedauwuna hevevethahee henee hadejejedāna vasehadede.

text: Nau haejāvesa hehejese nejechauthaunenee, nau haechagujanaugu, nau haevevetha,
text_for_embed: Luke 22:41 — Nau haejāvesa hehejese nejechauthaunenee, nau haechagujanaugu, nau haevevetha,

text: Nāchau, hith Nananene vadauusedaunenagu, jegudanauwune nuu vāenau hehethee Nananenau: hau nāhauwuvathehaa, hau Nananene, hadnaasauau, hathauhuk.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:42 — Nāchau, hith Nananene vadauusedaunenagu, jegudanauwune nuu vāenau hehethee Nananenau: hau nāhauwuvathehaa, hau Nananene, hadnaasauau, hathauhuk.

text: Nau haenauhauva hautheaune hehethee hejavaa, haedadāevaa.
text_for_embed: Luke 22:43 — Nau haenauhauva hautheaune hehethee hejavaa, haedadāevaa.
